body:
Pedestrian Improvement Project | | | |
---
| | |
# [Join me next Wednesday (3/27) in Broadmoor!](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f659cb037c&e=c0babbc643)
---
|
---
| [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e704092bb9&e=c0babbc643) **Come celebrate the completion of Broadmoor’s Safe Routes to Schools project** The Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project has completed and you are invited to join me for a ribbon cutting 10:30 a.m., Wednesday March 27 at the student drop off location off Park Plaza Drive near 87th Street. The estimated construction cost for this Project is $1,655,330 which includes $1,300,000 in federal Quick-Strike Program funding which I helped secure as a Commissioner on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission. The project includes installing pavement striping along the outside edges of the travel lanes on 87th Street to help provide drivers with a narrower sense of the roadway width. It also includes modifications at the intersection of 87th Street and Larchmont/Stoneyford Drive that will include painted medians and a painted bulb-out area at the corner of 87th Street and Larchmont Drive. These intersection modifications are intended to provide for a narrower area/travel lane to encourage drivers to slow down. The project stretches from 87th Street and Southgate Avenue to Sullivan Avenue and South Park Plaza Drive from 87th Street to approximately Palmcrest Drive. The work in general terms includes a raised midblock crosswalk on South Park Plaza Drive near Garden Village Elementary School and intersection improvements at 87th Street at South Park Plaza Drive/Nimitz Drive and 87th Street at Village Lane/Washington Street. I’m excited to see this project coming to completion as I’ve advocated for the safety of children walking to Garden Village and the nearby Ben Franklin Intermediate School. Thanks to the San Mateo Public Works department for overseeing this project which will benefit the neighborhood for generations to come.

| **Congresswoman Emilia Sykes Wins Democratic Nomination for Ohio’s 13th District ** **Pledges to Continue Prioritizing Lower Costs, Protecting Reproductive Freedom, Keeping Communities Safe, and Increasing Access to High Quality, Affordable Healthcare**
---
| AKRON, OH – Today, Congresswoman Emilia Sykes released the following statement after securing the Democratic nomination for Ohio’s 13th Congressional District:

"I'm proud to have earned your support to be the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 13th Congressional District," said Congresswoman Sykes. “I’m running for reelection to continue our work building on the progress we’ve made to lower costs, protect our fundamental freedoms, keep our communities safe, and increase access to affordable, quality healthcare. As we look to November, I’m focused on fighting everyday for Northeast Ohioans and confident that this team will be victorious.”

Sykes is serving the second year of her first two-year term representing Ohio’s 13th Congressional District. Her top priority is making government work for her district. She has introduced important bills to improve the lives of constituents across the district, including the Lower Your Taxes Act to expand the Earned Income and Child Tax Credits and the Safer Homes and Families Act to protect victims and survivors of domestic violence. During her tenure, she has brought back more than $115 million in federal dollars to the district, including $42 million to improve public transit in Northeast Ohio. Sykes also helped secure Akron’s designation as a tech hub for polymer development, meaning the region is eligible for hefty federal grants funded from a $10 billion reserve set aside in the CHIPS Act.

Dear Supporters, Friends, and Family,

In a significant victory for Democrats in Ohio, Matt Diemer has won the Democratic primary for Ohio's 7th congressional district, setting the stage for a campaign centered on congressional reform. Diemer, a staunch advocate for depolarizing American politics, has made headlines with his campaign's focus to "**Make Congress Work Again**." "The people of Ohio's 7th district have spoken loud and clear: they are tired of the endless dysfunction and partisanship that has plagued Congress," Diemer said. “Let's be honest, Congress IS the problem! Our campaign is about bridging divides, ending the gridlock, and ensuring Congress can once again pass laws that benefit all Americans." Diemer has been vocal in criticizing the current Republican majority for what he describes as "nearly two years of infighting and dysfunction," attributing these issues to the GOP's inability to manage its majority effectively. He emphasized the importance of protecting democracy from individuals and groups that sought to undermine the country's institutions, especially in light of the events of January 6th. "**End the Dysfunction**!" Diemer aims to address the critical issues preventing Congress from effectively governing, such as the challenges highlighted in recent discussions around government shutdowns and border security. Diemer is also committed to tackling the root causes of **Congress's dismal 14% approval rating** by proposing significant reforms in campaign finance, insider stock trading, and anti-gerrymandering. He advocates for eliminating the influence of Super PACs and lobbyist money in politics, which he believes contributes to wasteful campaign spending and a lack of accountability. Diemer points to the example of Max Miller, who spent $3 million yet still lost Cuyahoga County, as evidence of the need for change. "Our democracy is at a crossroads," Diemer stated. "We can either continue down the path of division and discord, or we can choose a new direction—one where Congress works for the people, where integrity and transparency are the cornerstones of our governance. I am here to fight for the latter, to **Make Congress Work Again** for every American." As the general election approaches, Diemer's campaign is gaining momentum, resonating with voters across Ohio's 7th district who are eager for change and a Congress that prioritizes the nation's well-being over partisan politics. **But I can’t win in November without you.** [And please consider contributing to our campaign here!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqt9pLRmaUboVWzo37jjmhahGPxGltLdVNW6YQ6bODwylMCeEEEw_wfOjMw5NXTROu-VpqyM9hxXBIYTamJIUSa_BPl1n6USmbEuOthomu2Ot1V7vnnn1n6NrHfHKFODbGoqe6vz2TrRPbv1sOEX_TsVSxlkpzBFII_TadmbyQNKla7BX6VLxuT0BM9Ym3UF03hQpmnSb5jVCrnQ5Q4dhKqQCJA9G3pB59GxopDX1P-jUIzcFk4onW1KrH8xU_0TQOWA-GR-ZRc-qKUYjSVLSn60qVyF59phtHxLFgJImBm7ouzUWsZw5JI2SPNHF4QZl6TN2T63_mICewK9oQ6BRucyeOga7r6TAsNBtk5OiIium1DbWEuNoDrs6cNbZRGUzk4sFUcTEEimoXOpEpaJnN_-/44t/mOAjnwd7RQOQ9pW9aNw-dg/h0/h001.GEZyGddEX46qm9oUd91ynS5ONQKdYzdM0XKUr2OTzTs) Whether you are new to the Diem Team or fought alongside us last cycle, we are going to need all hands on deck to Make Congress Work Again in 2024. Friend, I want to personally thank you for always standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81284694/461993715/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4909-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZDcxNDExMy01YWU2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WdVV1GTI5GCqWhGxaiYCyD8geI_MJp4Af9-KIfSnyRY=)
Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**
But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York in 2022. **Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave in 2024 — and they're directly targeting my seat.** I refuse to accept a single cent from corporate PACs, so I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to compete with their right-wing megadonors.

body:
| Friend,

I noticed a familiar face in a recent issue of _American Rifleman._ (Yes, I really read it. You’ve got to keep your friends close and enemies closer, after all.)

To no one’s surprise, the NRA took out a full-page ad bashing me — and by extension, all of the folks who are a part of this movement to reform our gun laws, make progressive change, and elect the next generation of bold, young leaders.

The ads in these magazines are always good for a laugh — but this kind of stuff also reminds me how scared of us they really are. I’ve said it before, but **Gen Z will most certainly outlive the NRA.** The gun lobby’s glory days are behind them now. 📚 Every child deserves access to a high-quality education

Fellow American - My name is Nancy Mace.

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. **I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it.**

**Through grit and the American dream, I was the first woman to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets and now proudly serve in Congress and fight for folks like you to have the same opportunities that I was granted.**

Unlike a lot of folks in Washington, I’ve been working since I was 17. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other.

Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices.

_Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth._

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a7dfe3b46f2d499daa559a10b7a7d25d&_e=K9rN-5rb9Nn-btkXgdRCYUeQMUyZF2pHlwGXyctmGg-Hgp_IUqif9xbnPmKsLSqrWnaxnRClsOMjpgq6qz_0GgFTcofnd2baTRTtGWSCQdJL90XPB9blpetZP3feYe2QAsL9toRwZ42f04rId0eRyHCxPlBUtu3Lp3GRCK3FxpI8SfUhrjl_DdcDG1puDtsKUDVTZjsL6p5tzayFhCMnzrFMMfVfhlGV-O-e3Qgokf0IU54Skriu3u-ThpFS_emNobKkJg-SuE5yDOSbOu9aikz-j3Oim_o6ZTQCEVVxJynra5WkGcQGD8Kqd9_JRtaYAv7oIwbFpfDrGtKP6eic-mVgEvoCxtyZWE0KEB0DWbrm3gBfnUGIcZhn7l_gADjcoYpz4_A3qQve7CxjGf4wHA%3D%3D)

I’m a high school dropout who started out working at Waffle House to pay the bills and put food on the table. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies — and I am a better woman because of it. It’s clear Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Someone who knows what it’s like to actually earn a living and make sacrifices. Someone who didn’t grow up with a silver spoon in their mouth. But here’s where I need your help – the rich continue to run Congress because they have the funds to do so.But I have you... I have no friends in Washington, Fellow American because I don’t play into the bull**** swamp and I can’t be bought. There was a time in my life when I never thought I would graduate high school, let alone serve in Congress. body:
Maryland is losing teachers as Democrats throw tax dollars. In Congress I will work to ensure students have a world class education. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/coxforcongress/school-crisis-droves-of-teachers-resigning?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
---
| |
# 5000+ Teachers Have Resigned In Maryland Since COVID - and More Keep Leaving.
, Maryland Teachers are resigning at alarming rates with [over 1500 leaving Montgomery County schools in the last two years alone](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=387cf6bfeb&e=5bb5efcda7), and the substitute teacher rates are around 85% in our state! Substitute teachers make on average less than half the daily wage of permanent and certified teachers, usually less than $2600 a month _before_ taxes.

And with inflation rising cumulatively by 66% over the last 20 years, and over 9% under Biden, that is hardly any buying power for staples such as food, housing, electricity, gas and fuel, and transportation, more less to live and enjoy the fruits of your labor.

_While I have twice voted for teacher salary increases_ , however, on the House Floor vote against the "Blue Print" I gave a speech warning that the so-called "Kirwan Blue-Print for Schools" was a $32 BILLION increase in funding with a SuperBoard establishment and would not go to teachers and classrooms, and would not help Maryland students. _Instead, it would hand power and money over to selected and appointed administrative bureaucrats and teacher's unions without accountability by parents and their elected officials_.

_That's exactly what has happened._

The General Assembly passed the $32 BILLION package and SuperBoard anyway \- including new policies of centralization and power over County school boards.

Now two years on they discover it could bankrupt our state without massive tax increases and appears to date to be _lowering_ our academic learning for our students rather than improving education.

Droves of teachers have resigned and 85% of classes are being taught at half-cost - many without supportive training and preparation for the new influx of immigrant children who speak no English.

_The future of America rests on the shoulders of the youth of today. I am deeply troubled by the plight of children today who cannot get the education they need to succeed and compete in the world_.

It's time to restore sanity and common sense to our education system.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=c9072bf8f1&e=5bb5efcda7)

For over thirty years I have fought for education freedom, parental rights and the right of teachers to safe and free classrooms. While education freedom is growing, woke ideology, billions in waste and a lack of honor, respect and pride in our public education is costing our State and families dearly.

As your Member of Congress I firmly believe we can and will turn this around by God's grace and provide world class schools and learning for our students whose families do not have the ability to choose private or home schools.

Students need to respect their teachers and even a hint of violence needs to be dealt with swiftly and as an example to all. Classrooms can be mandated under federal law to establish peaceful environments and SROs and teacher protection are a must. Students should be taught - like they do in the UK with equal funding allowed to religious and moral based education required for all \- to respect God, their country, and the adults in their lives including law enforcement. _No more excuses_. It's time we establish order in our schools and juvenile policy.

Learning should be exciting - a discovery of all there is to know as an adventure, to seek answers for life, develop interests and skills, to make discoveries no one else has ever made, write books that help advance society, prepare for careers that uplift mankind, teach determination in doing what is right and develop character that changes nations for the better.

Stand with me tonight in support of our teachers, schools and students. We must ensure Congress doesn't forget District Six teachers, students, schools and parents.

Make sure that all of us have a voice in Congress and not just the teacher's unions and the powerful administrative bureaucracy.

I pledge to put our teachers and students first in Congress.

For the children,

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=fbaf59a1e7&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD6)

I have an urgent deadline for fundraising due with our FEC report in just 12 days - please [help me reach our goal with your donation](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=d77be77106&e=5bb5efcda7) of $5, $10, $15, $25 or even $100 tonight. A few years ago, members of the world’s elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, “We need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that’s not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

subject: More Chesterfield GOP Corruption Exposed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase
body:
You Can't Make This Up
| | |
---
| Friends, Many of you know I have my share of political enemies. They will say or do anything to destroy me politically or personally, even harassing my family.
I'm proudly MAGA and just like President Trump, they want to tie me up in court now for helping to defeat the Chesterfield GOP Swamp.
While I'm super excited that we won yesterday, I still have to face the cost for beating the establishment. Yes; they are now trying to tie me up in court, falsely accusing me of assault.
That's right. Assault and batter. That's a class 1 misdemeanor. Now I have to appear in General District Court for a criminal offense. The same tactics they used on Trump, they are using on me. Only I don't have millions to fight this.
Here's the story.
Yesterday, after Chesterfield GOP Chair Leslie Haley presented me a letter stating I couldn't be a part of the Virginia GOP for 4 years, they had a trap set for me. Once again I caught them. They would deny my vote and then video my reaction.
You know me. I'm going to stand up for myself when I've been wronged. They know that too.
Do you know who they asked to serve as the Sergeant of Arms, which is basically security for our election?
They asked an ex disgruntled employee of mine who had harassed and stalked me for over a year. In fact, I was successfully granted a restraining order against him in February 2023 by a Richmond General District Court and it was extended an additional 6 months through November 2023.
That's who they picked to serve as security.
Not only was he asked to serve as security, he brought his girlfriend along to do his dirty work for him.
He's been determined to destroy me politically and personally for years. The Old Guard Chesterfield County GOP executive leadership team, who was defeated tonight, and thought it was acceptable to ask him to serve as security.
After getting told I wasn't eligible to vote, I called the Governor to see if he could help out. He responded but was unavailable.
Then, I went outside to the line of people who were still waiting to vote and showed them the letter given to me by the Old Guard and said, this is exactly why we need new leadership.
I'm sure it doesn't surprise you that they refused to allow me to vote.
They refused to allow me to vote, presenting me with a letter advising me that "based on my actions during the 2023 Election Cycle, that I had chosen to withdraw my membership from the Republican Party of Virginia and thus my ability to participate in the party process for four years."
The Sargeant of Arms had his girlfriend to harass me, provoke me and then catch my reaction on video. Thankfully, I kept my cool.

| | Friend, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbrebod3lk4iuuutqo2f09kdmbil1ftvfjs136vg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30cjh61o77c9h2bs)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn7280i0n4rnp3o9u26hqofvsik3c9mlv6j8m940_rp22sh2s8i6ep30cjh61o77c9h2bs) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Charlie's spring campus visits are underway, and he's been astonished at what he's seen so far from America's students, as more and more students are unafraid to identify as conservative and anti-woke. ## Supreme Court Allows Texas To Arrest Illegal Migrants
The Supreme Court on Tuesday overturned its stay and [voted 6-3 to allow Texas ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH8N3rDgGZt6YOjiLV07Wpg8klfxYQEJ7b-v2rHqeLrldO-X_WIpULq92Yim-bxb1-iJ-8RBcFC7Gq7GIwJOAxqppViV1GIe7sa7ycllObTWqFatJ73IeZWgvUR9ODeQAQFKTCDEOi8KRrGs8ws4lPY4xDx7pgReqeUyfmRK7Y4-fOUnltHlOARzb-2sbHplsDHYeu9jOlzCXn88g-3MgRq5ymCrj7NgRO7yo7S_zG0IuVfe8NNWjsnn4pBTjHQrtlFOPNjOi0tWKli1HIq5np1CoLpopsQtWgq_Te3fQ98BAAD__31VaYg)to enforce its law allowing the state to arrest illegal immigrants. On Monday, Justice Sam Alito blocked enforcement of the law in an administrative stay until the full court could act. On Tuesday, the full court surprised officials by allowing the law to go into effect immediately, pending a full review by the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. The three liberal justices [issued public dissents](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUxvGngY4JHgG1oLiN3dz2luYoR-UGxcCZmd2338xuu_Uv-b7k_-8-3TGmeG5_8SDPa55w4fikqVWgFZjJyOBXIqBWkm-6Rg-m6bSVu0eDqHXXD11vEZ1zgwlz44a1X0MIZGT0oMHoFrQerDNw026wPSzU4Dxra1dhNIXIudz-53jyTmv6zE8qtyUfMvmd-aqi_SNgFDDyTntM6W0CxkLbIyHHfAoYl_worGZkTlQFjMYagN6q-rgKHaR-nOkDq0r4UpWRSV05xYUUZ4WlUGV1xK3gye8FWXy4XjGlWF0njN4OjN_Xkn-N9BUAAP__qwZqJw) from the 6-3 decision, saying it would cause enforcement chaos. The court said it could revisit the issue quickly if the Fifth Circuit doesn't decide soon. The Justice Department says the law is unconstitutional because authority over immigration status belongs to the federal government. Texas has argued that its borders are being overrun because the government isn't enforcing the law.
## Housing Prices Far Outstrip Decades of Inflation
U.S. home prices [rose 2.4 times the inflation rate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGuozAQheGnMZ3RMNgkFC62ocu2W6LBjONZGTvCVlDefpWtb_1JR0f_n8f6IEmSn7_pYNdCWck3efM6agSNZjXd7gIz8tixG24DzGa4ge2ig8nuRBPi6LctBLIAZrvD3dBgiHnvxCGggREBZjsZ7GGa7R09D7RtYG1QBniXVs7-b5HcIof0KW8-e1-OLrnY2quq8ZfCReFyXVfv8-a_qHD5TitcYFS4DPPX40fHcrB-neK56khv1qdUzjpQbXzqFilrySFRk5J1lexZt8h6mCeofWxH6k63vy5JSep0UwaeB0n6f6f9GOdfAAAA__9oc2UW) over the past 60 years, meaning a $500,000 house would cost $177,000 if homes had just increased at the same rate as other prices. More simply, prices are ten times higher today than in 1963, but housing prices are 24 times higher. Experts say the added costs are due to a housing supply shortage, the high cost of land, the increased average size of homes, and various zoning restrictions. Surveys consistently show that housing costs have a political impact. A Redfin survey shows that over 50% of Americans say [affordability affects their voting plans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GSrCAQAL8GMi0YQR4BwUvM9tILrVGGda4QtpRba__-ai--uIPu_rzNN-TM5f6BO4WW6oxr4yfNQweqAzMbGUMiAhokBe208kY7ZeUWRoyIpLX3jlK0TicTaTFOr7hoPXjJARQYNYBS3o4GejV6-w9W0rgsytokjKLIrR79V-XSNkr5VZ909GvdZQ5ba49TDP8FTAKm67r6g2Li8sYCpkLXKWDa6vfJ5d5hSvWIuHDm9uoo09q4lu6dIGCSR4iPi3Pmc3TCqPuOnH897c_rnwAAAP__wwxZHw), and another survey shows it as [the No. 1 issue for liberals and No. 3 ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvsTvQeGzDUrh4Dd2-NiUy9rBMYvAKJovy91FSp7-60nm7T_fIhffH_7hRkKVOMQm_aLINQoNucjqHhQjJagqmNzA404PXa-jMzfbeD45STgv4jA672c5A2CeTo-aAgA4sAgy-c9hCN_gbJjJxnsH7RTmgzFKP9r3yList5au-6GhT3XQJq8jzVPafwlHheF1Xe1AsdEoUuljS-tMpHBHQNpTqXjdOTf2UUuuHwlEfIT8vLoXPrlcOHlvk8vuWP6XfAQAA__8n61R-)for conservatives.
## Fish Tale: Man Snags World-Record Paddlefish
A Kansas man set a world record by catching a 164-pound, 13-ounce paddlefish at the Lake of the Ozarks on his first "snagging" trip. [Here's a photo](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D-PnTAQBPBPA90-Let_UFCkobu0KdGC14dzBiPb707Jp4_e1aln9JNmfr2tbxxTvN5_8ilzC3nlvcVPWRUQAulV934OIiSql3lwA056cGj6Y1ZB-WnU3hlLmtxu7CDOTSaEfdwQdR9nQtKoCHEyVtMD7WRG2mXgbUNjQqdRfGy5PH7neLVDQvqTP6U89nz2aT5au2unfnS0dLS0Z6r8lUvyr7ijpd65tNrRktshpaOFYbAa7vy8PPh45crPAiHWQ8rJFxSRVCFe8I1AkT0XDzd7n-TVAm6Q-EMgB2iHQP7L5ePlc2lxT7JOoqwdRg_KsQGjFMJGFgEV2yEEUs6Nj6OdqS-zv79iSrFa12l8Pzmm71Htvxf_CwAA___cvXxA). name: Geoff Diehl
subject: Balancing the Books
body:
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-y2qG10PyfX51tDYRmzvuypChyePX3Ly0fcKtzDjMaX04YbSUxwIdQ-kiSiOtc06H0UZ86rXhioAtEF73NDDRnG3ocRIx1GftfSb8g2XKr335Up_ecGxQ0yGPUI7PuKZj_XBHalE7Hpk85rRoV1Ry0kpnfygZWh_jhznSilFNFWpUtqokdkJSWTct9OknFod&c=-wftGeBdRf455P6OzpStCf2_GT0a6tAhG6GwrOqt7vgRh0tTLIE7Vw==&ch=ngzlp4DWPQELaalTzFmPvESor5pljRtAfwlelmEIdlCnHeDyJtjrXw==)
---
| Hello All,
Thank you for your tremendous support during the recent campaign for State Committee! Now that the election has concluded, my Campaign Manager Amanda Orlando and I, want to take this opportunity to correct the record about false claims made about me, personally, and our campaign for Governor over the last few months.
In 2023, the Office of Campaign and Political Finance (OCPF) conducted regular audits of state-wide campaigns that had concluded, including the "Diehl for Governor" committee. OCPF also audited MassGOP. In their review, OCPF identified some MassGOP expenditures which they required to be listed as "in-kind" donations to the Diehl campaign.
One of those payments was $1,000 from the MassGOP to the Howie Carr Show in the fall of 2022, for radio ads regarding Maura Healey's "America is Burning" comment. In December of 2023, the party and OCPF advised us that the Diehl committee needed to amend the 2022 report to reflect it as an in-kind donation. On a recent show, Howie has claimed that I owed him money, which is patently false. We amended our report as instructed on 1/22/2024 with the full knowledge and approval of the current chair, Amy Carnevale, and John Milligan, her Executive Director.
Further, in 2022, Mittcom was hired as a vendor, by the MassGOP, to produce and run TV and radio ads to promote policy positions that would benefit Republican candidates. Currently, Mittcom is suing the MassGOP for overdue payments. Despite claims brought by individuals that this debt was incurred by the Diehl committee, it was not. In fact, no member of the Diehl committee, nor the Committee itself, has been named as a defendant in that lawsuit.
Ironically, during the OCPF audits, we DID find that a number of donors to the Diehl committee had contributed more than the allowable, annual limit. A combination of data entry errors and misinterpretations by our compliance firm (hired to make sure state law was followed) have created a situation in which we need to reimburse a handful of individual donors for what they gave over the limit.
As we move forward in 2024, I'll be raising funds into the campaign account so that we can ensure that all problems identified by OCPF are remediated and our reports are updated.
I've always prided myself on being honest and forthright with my supporters, the voters, and the press. If you're willing to help, you can make a campaign contribution here: [https://secure.winred.com/diehl-committee/donate-today](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-y2qG10PyfX51tDYRmzvuypChyePX3Ly0fcKtzDjMaX04YbSUxwIdQ-kiSiOtc06H0UZ86rXhioAtEF73NDDRnG3ocRIx1GftfSb8g2XKr335Up_ecGxQ0yGPUI7PuKZj_XBHalE7Hpk85rRoV1Ry0kpnfygZWh_jhznSilFNFWpUtqokdkJSWTct9OknFod&c=-wftGeBdRf455P6OzpStCf2_GT0a6tAhG6GwrOqt7vgRh0tTLIE7Vw==&ch=ngzlp4DWPQELaalTzFmPvESor5pljRtAfwlelmEIdlCnHeDyJtjrXw==)
I am also considering a run for State Senate to work on the difficult issues facing the Commonwealth right now. Stay tuned for more information related to that potential campaign!
All my best, Geoff
---

name: Michael
subject: Roger’s message to Wisconsin conservatives
body:
This weekend, Roger delivered a critical message to hundreds of dedicated grassroots activists No images? [Click here](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-e-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-n/) [](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-r/) Friend,This weekend, Roger spoke with a packed house of Wisconsin conservatives who are united in their desire to stop our country's decline and restore our nation's greatness. It was so inspiring to see scores of Wisconsinites take time out of their busy lives to talk about how America can meet its challenges.We wanted to share some of Roger's remarks at the Brown County Republican Party Lincoln Reagan Dinner because they highlight exactly why Roger is running for Congress and why we need effective conservatives representing Northeast Wisconsin in the House. [The Importance Of Northeast Wisconsin](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-y/) _" The truth of the matter is, to win elections in Wisconsin you have to do well in Northeast Wisconsin. It used to be ... the WOW Counties, that they'll turn out votes out there.... but it doesn't work anymore. Later this year, the eyes of the nation, dare I say the eyes of the world will descend upon Northeast Wisconsin... to see what we do here, to see what we are made of. _**_I know if we keep the enthusiasm we have generated here tonight, if that energy is matched this November, we are holding on to the House, we are taking back the Senate, and Donald Trump will be the next president of the United States!_**_"_ [Securing Our Border](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-j/) _" We know what the issues are; the problem is we don't have elected officials in Washington willing to solve them. I want you to know that in me, you have a proven conservative who's willing to do the job - and that begins first and foremost with the catastrophe that is growing at our southern border!__Over the last four years, 8.4 million illegal aliens crossed our border. Surprise, surprise, when you remove the Trump-era policies that brought illegal immigration to a trickle, what happens is an explosion of illegal immigration.__**In me, you will have someone that will stand next to Donald Trump to secure our border once and for all**_ _**! "**_ [Father. Captain. Builder. Conservative](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-t/) _" I am a third-generation homebuilder. My grandfather moved to Wisconsin from the Dakotas in the early 1950s to build houses here. My father learned the trade from my grandfather; I learned the trade from my father; and God willing, my five boys will learn the trade from me one day.__Nothing gives me greater joy and happiness than partnering with hard-working Wisconsinites_ _and helping them achieve their version of the American dream.__**And finally, nothing means more to me than my family. My**_ _**greatest accomplishment in life will always be my family, I've got an amazing**_ _**wife and together we homeschool five little boys in Appleton.** "_ Roger is going to be a constant presence in the 8th district as the campaign gets under way. He would love to see you on the trail, visit your community or organization, or talk with you directly about your concerns so please feel free to contact our campaign. [Get In Touch](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-i/) If you're interested in supporting Roger's campaign, you can do so by clicking the button below.Thanks,
Michael [Support Roger's Campaign](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-d/) [](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-h/) [](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-k/)[](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-u/) [](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-o/) | Learn more at:
[RothForWisconsin.com](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-b/) P.O. Box 2224
Appleton, Wisconsin 54912 [Preferences](https://rothforwisconsin.updatemyprofile.com/y-xkrkdg-BBA6B9EC-duljhuiyly-p) | [Unsubscribe](https://rothforwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-u-xkrkdg-duljhuiyly-q/)

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very

body:
The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act provided the largest investment ever made in community violence intervention programs.
#

Friends -
The _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ provided $250 million in funding for community violence intervention programs, also known as CVI programs. According to 2019 research from GIFFORDS Law Center, CVI programs have been proven to reduce homicides by as much as 60 percent.
[**Will you add your name today to say you support community violence intervention programs as a tool to keep our communities safe from gun violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_cvipetition_mar24/?source=em240320-1-30&refcode2=7797.3935704.QA-879&akid=7797%2E3935704%2EQA-879)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_cvipetition_mar24/?source=em240320-1-30&refcode2=7797.3935704.QA-879&akid=7797%2E3935704%2EQA-879)**
CVI programs use community-based strategies to reduce violence by delivering comprehensive services to individuals at the highest risk of engaging in or being victimized by interpersonal violence. Through these programs, trained professionals are able to connect with members of communities and provide them with alternative strategies to resolve conflict, instead of resorting to violence.
The _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ provided the largest investment ever made in community violence intervention programs. But in order for community violence intervention programs to work, they must be properly implemented.
[**Safer communities are within our reach. Will you sign on to support the implementation of community violence intervention programs?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_cvipetition_mar24/?source=em240320-1-30&refcode2=7797.3935704.QA-879&akid=7797%2E3935704%2EQA-879)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_cvipetition_mar24/?source=em240320-1-30&refcode2=7797.3935704.QA-879&akid=7797%2E3935704%2EQA-879)**
Thank you. Your support is critical in the fight to keep our communities safe from gun violence.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=7797%2E3935704%2EQA-879) if you'd like to unsubscribe. name: Bob Casey
subject: The map is back
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2391%2E552475%2EHKFhCk)
The map is back, Peter.
In 2020, while the Nation waited for every vote to be counted in the presidential election between Joe Biden and Donald Trump, I spent a week in front of my map of Pennsylvania breaking down what was happening.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240320-1?refcode=em20240320-1&refcode2=2391_552475_HKFhCk&akid=2391%2E552475%2EHKFhCk)
It caught on, and I got a reputation for being a bit of a map guy.
Then in 2022, I pulled out the map again to break down Pennsylvania’s vote tallies until my friends Senator John Fetterman and Governor Josh Shapiro officially won their historic victories.
Now, the map is back and it’s better (and bigger) than ever — and we’re covering it with the names of supporters from all across the Commonwealth.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240320-1?refcode=em20240320-1&refcode2=2391_552475_HKFhCk&akid=2391%2E552475%2EHKFhCk)
What happens in Pennsylvania will determine the fate of our entire country. If we lose this race, Democrats could lose both the Senate and the White House – impacting everything from women’s rights to the promise of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. If we’re going to win this thing, it’s going to take an army of supporters like you, Peter, chipping in when you can.
We’re going to continue covering our map of Pennsylvania from top to bottom with the names of supporters like you — because grassroots donors will make all the difference in our fight to defend Pennsylvania’s seat and hold our Senate majority.
[**Will you stake your spot on the map today? Donate any amount right now, and we’ll add your name.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240320-1?refcode=em20240320-1&refcode2=2391_552475_HKFhCk&akid=2391%2E552475%2EHKFhCk)
**[Get on the map ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240320-1?refcode=em20240320-1&refcode2=2391_552475_HKFhCk&akid=2391%2E552475%2EHKFhCk)**
Thank you for being on my team.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Texas Senate Bill 4
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

SB 4 — the Texas “show me your papers” law — is bad. Its disregard for 100
years of Supreme Court precedent defining federal supremacy on immigration
and international relations is based on a deeply flawed claim that Texas
is waging war against some sort of “invading army.”

While that rhetoric is really popular on the extreme right, it is in no
way connected to the facts. And it’s going to end up making the people
living here less safe, less secure, less protected by the law.

There are a lot of desperate people trying to seek refuge, join family,
and find opportunity in this country. Without legal options, many are
crossing in between legal ports of entry. That’s a problem that can be
handled with more resources (though Trump and Republicans have blocked
bipartisan solutions that would have added 4,300 new asylum officers and
100 new immigration judges, in addition to billions more in enforcement
funds) and better policy (from more effective use of parole authority and
work authorizations to completely overhauling our immigration laws).

But what’s happening at the border in no way constitutes an “invasion.”
That kind of rhetoric is not only untrue, it inspires the unhinged and
violent among us to terrorize our communities. Like when a man inspired by
this rhetoric walked into an El Paso Walmart to kill 23 people, claiming
to repel the “Hispanic invasion of Texas.”

And the only court that’s actually looked at the law (a federal district
court in Texas) found that it is likely unconstitutional. Because it is.
Over and over again for a century, the Supreme Court has clearly said that
only the federal government can make and enforce immigration law.

But perhaps worst of all is the breakdown in law and order that this is
sure to produce. How will police decide who looks like or acts like an
immigrant in order to stop them or question them? This will lead to racial
profiling and mass civil rights abuses against immigrants and U.S.
citizens alike. And when a significant part of the population fears law
enforcement, we will be less safe — people will be less likely to report
crime, testify in a trial, serve as a witness.

Permanently blocking this law should be a no-brainer for the Supreme
Court. But yesterday, it chose to punt the case back to a lower court,
leading to even more chaos and more confusion when it comes to immigration
policy in this country. My hope is that after fully hearing the case,
learning the facts, and understanding the consequences of this deeply
troubling bill, the courts will rule against it and restore rule of law.
But we can only hope.

However, when it comes to elections — deciding who the government will be
in Texas after 2024, who will represent us in the Senate starting in 2025,
and whether we elect a President that believes in the rule of law and the
value of immigration or one who thinks that immigrants are “poisoning the
blood of America” — we can do more than just hope. We can vote and we can
help others register and cast their ballots too.

To make sure Powered by People is doing its part, we’re training Volunteer
Deputy Registrars (VDRs) every day who will help register and turn out the
voters we need to change what’s happening here. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240320.65yHYo&refcode=ema20240320-239524&t=1002&akid=239524%2E444211%2EpxmfUq ]If you can, I hope
you’ll support this work with a donation today.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240320.65yHYo&refcode=ema20240320-239524&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=239524%2E444211%2EpxmfUq ]DONATE $3

We will change this together.

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=239524%2E444211%2EpxmfUq

| | **Who is the American Federation for Children Growth Fund? **
---
We’re an organization of parents, activists, and policy professionals all united under one mission: _bringing school choice to parents and students in every state._

We believe:
📚 Every child deserves access to a high-quality education
🏫 Parents should have a say in what school their child attends
✏️ Education tax dollars should follow students, whether the child attends public or private school

**And 72% of Americans agree.**

Yet, not every state offers even one alternative to traditional public schools. That’s not fair to students or parents – _and we’re fighting to make that change._
---

A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86cf8ae441d040aabef38f5903277cdd&_e=TmYuPDm86itmInJ5TEABMFMsKeiNWzyDqXoFMaTAWbzb_TqNUO0rfIBO65rRZinyKAIhkO9-DXFpU8gj7htPSTHSIo0-1zzeCFsnwQ7w9YJqAVpy5_p5SJgTFD2WGAkL39oknat3rE66ymNDNBOQV8IfcVxgwHzAIrh3z5DmSOlCmLd2PMUotUEhZXmV6OJfqYTqGQ8gpJqKuU5Zo14CrG8-cfixshRpCdht2IDNqu4-mQdKu2Sh9zvcoP0W8CJCcixyOXHNYwLrMbTfAB6-6cTA8TI1q8_vMtjIeN970ppJI7rqBWnY701_xZXlTtj1MjL6PUQg-yFTiBcOuKZHQmtstQvnuxNlJgFt_jchztkeKehcBD_AN5DKA6LJpxp_IdmltINsR6cidOedGvfDFQ%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=86cf8ae441d040aabef38f5903277cdd&_e=TmYuPDm86itmInJ5TEABMFMsKeiNWzyDqXoFMaTAWbzb_TqNUO0rfIBO65rRZinyKAIhkO9-DXFpU8gj7htPSTHSIo0-1zzeCFsnwQ7w9YJqAVpy5_p5SJgTFD2WGAkL39oknat3rE66ymNDNBOQV8IfcVxgwHzAIrh3z5DmSOlCmLd2PMUotUEhZXmV6OJfqYTqGQ8gpJqKuU5Zo14CrG8-cfixshRpCdht2IDNqu4eP-ckrbWn8sqcp3VcBK4ty2Ze6mM1fyDqtKuk1xubGQffoeMh3b7WuAxP-_lPLV_FrUqtYDgx-zVP_ZH0rd45vxMFEo_aTdNVuIuKsaIa6rva9-Gzs-OdI1njzPNlfPzBLEuQsT9yCxS23O0OrGDUH_VuPAvwszn18P526wECJA%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

| | **THANK YOU! ** It felt like a dream. Being in a room filled with hundreds of my favorite people was the perfect way to ring in a new decade. Collectively, you all paint a beautiful tapestry of what Indiana can be at our best- a diverse, eclectic, and inclusive place filled with joy and hope for the future. Let's keep that momentum going.

**SHOUT OUTS:**

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Do this one thing to stand for life today
body:
highlight-blue {background-color: #648fc6;}
In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles

|
---
| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuplucgu3aejbnpg8bsjbt5npqqpuoi71l3k38j8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30cjim9ob2c3h2bs) For Life,
Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

Sherrod Brown

# 5000+ Teachers Have Resigned In Maryland Since COVID - and More Keep Leaving.
, Maryland Teachers are resigning at alarming rates with [over 1500 leaving Montgomery County schools in the last two years alone](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=7e13bcc2b9&e=5bb5efcda7), and the substitute teacher rates are around 85% in our state! Substitute teachers make on average less than half the daily wage of permanent and certified teachers, usually less than $2600 a month _before_ taxes.

And with inflation rising cumulatively by 66% over the last 20 years, and over 9% under Biden, that is hardly any buying power for staples such as food, housing, electricity, gas and fuel, and transportation, more less to live and enjoy the fruits of your labor.

_While I have twice voted for teacher salary increases_ , however, on the House Floor vote against the "Blue Print" I gave a speech warning that the so-called "Kirwan Blue-Print for Schools" was a $32 BILLION increase in funding with a SuperBoard establishment and would not go to teachers and classrooms, and would not help Maryland students. _Instead, it would hand power and money over to selected and appointed administrative bureaucrats and teacher's unions without accountability by parents and their elected officials_.

_That's exactly what has happened._

The General Assembly passed the $32 BILLION package and SuperBoard anyway \- including new policies of centralization and power over County school boards.

Now two years on they discover it could bankrupt our state without massive tax increases and appears to date to be _lowering_ our academic learning for our students rather than improving education.

Droves of teachers have resigned and 85% of classes are being taught at half-cost - many without supportive training and preparation for the new influx of immigrant children who speak no English.

_The future of America rests on the shoulders of the youth of today. I am deeply troubled by the plight of children today who cannot get the education they need to succeed and compete in the world_.

It's time to restore sanity and common sense to our education system.
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=ca22d6df0e&e=5bb5efcda7)

For over thirty years I have fought for education freedom, parental rights and the right of teachers to safe and free classrooms. While education freedom is growing, woke ideology, billions in waste and a lack of honor, respect and pride in our public education is costing our State and families dearly.

As your Member of Congress I firmly believe we can and will turn this around by God's grace and provide world class schools and learning for our students whose families do not have the ability to choose private or home schools.

Students need to respect their teachers and even a hint of violence needs to be dealt with swiftly and as an example to all. Classrooms can be mandated under federal law to establish peaceful environments and SROs and teacher protection are a must. Students should be taught - like they do in the UK with equal funding allowed to religious and moral based education required for all \- to respect God, their country, and the adults in their lives including law enforcement. _No more excuses_. It's time we establish order in our schools and juvenile policy.

Learning should be exciting - a discovery of all there is to know as an adventure, to seek answers for life, develop interests and skills, to make discoveries no one else has ever made, write books that help advance society, prepare for careers that uplift mankind, teach determination in doing what is right and develop character that changes nations for the better.

Stand with me tonight in support of our teachers, schools and students. We must ensure Congress doesn't forget District Six teachers, students, schools and parents.

Make sure that all of us have a voice in Congress and not just the teacher's unions and the powerful administrative bureaucracy.

I pledge to put our teachers and students first in Congress.

For the children,

[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=c68fa9ff19&e=5bb5efcda7)
Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (R-MD6)

Every dollar helps us pay for voter outreach and media! [](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=f89b3e22ba&e=5bb5efcda7)

Peter, correct me if I'm wrong -- _but I 'm willing to bet you're frustrated by what you're seeing and hearing from Washington lately. _

**I know I am.**
**And I know millions of Americans feel the same way. **
**Here 's three reasons why:**

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a98d4f1bcbb046eaaf4e6636740f63d6&_e=F2GEseAu3jGG87nL8cpNh-qyPNhspjyuVFxG-f0HqM6FLYjHPK2Fy-WtDGLULupQN7tJsl4JXC7mAXX75w0EOw-JDiH27Xc8jU43S8AOiTU-8ToNBRGg6eQ9h-7_uFDavqyf1caIG-7h43AHzDewe6HfL0BxknpsVIGhIMkdwErQZcnACWewaWKlvDjVZkMgdQkaZ66BEbIUf952AULj8cTn7kkAwowoKS44QBsHs6Evq-YXcNEm2KeinKoQlQdNtgyQijI4EcoF9rBjjD6S3tBTtTgfdaJl6lkc_fgbqOF7j8DNsv5CQouWW17sSHS1Dgo7JY_NmTNeC9OcTtRYmWkhNU1SFUfR85-uW58VmYr1FUkLpaPN9bqSuigcmfwH)

Every American can agree on that.

But at the very least, we should be able to count on our leaders to _**tell the truth, listen to the people they serve, and put America FIRST. **_

---
**That 's why I'm proud to endorse President Trump -- AGAIN!**

Peter, despite all the problems facing our country, I still believe the American Dream is worth fighting for.

I still have faith that our best days are ahead.

I still have pride in our past -- and hope for our future.

_**But none of that matters if we don 't have the right leaders in Washington.**_
_**And in just FOUR years, President Trump proved he can deliver:**_
* **The most secure southern border in American history**
* **New peace deals in the Middle East**
* **Economic success like we 've never seen before**
* **A stronger, more resilient military**

But all that has been lost in just THREE years under President Biden.
America needs conservative leadership now more than ever before, and that's exactly why we MUST win Congress, the Senate, and the White House in November.

| Hi friend -
---
I’m coming to you today because a legal case must be built to stop illegal immigrant voter registration. I’m asking for your help.
Here’s what we know:
By [Executive Order](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4n6aWBcMC8ry3MP8bGZ9oiitYX0cgjGiGk8NQyQEKRB-jrYGZunpSDXXHUsTh7N3V0BBDt3yHvFVnoB1qTv1wq7pnteNuQ17zF_3NI1qJErp05rLaplPVLuIRsg1MZQ-8SYDaxiMVYRajTrvYsmYAGbkY_fDcPTvUKTNqe2dmIOkTx6AI1NU3C76ggJJuXBo5c3U2qw2BhRBJZCWS1O6sFqosGeCGLxvToUiIfm-BB59h10lNWscbfF1VmIjBHxAIBPJjPqdvtpWgqGZWM5UiDZMuPZqcPT7POWN10rG0zYTPojlCpdU0rpRRNGf56NuFA/44t/oVLf5CPGTSmkWMb0SwvhCg/h2/h001.s_TvOuV70HeWbAEuRyAeTTOH5REWMJZVP0ZBgGOLRxA), the Biden Administration weaponized all agencies of the federal government to push voter registration in populations where eligibility statuses cannot be effectively tracked, like students, prisoners, and noncitizens.
Then, they opened the borders to a tsunami of illegal immigrants. In just the last three years, over 10,000,000 illegal aliens have been added to the federal dole, being flown on your dime to battleground states across the country.
But the Biden regime, parroted by mainstream media, are quick to stress that illegal immigrants, or as the Administration is now calling them [“New Americans”](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.sV4MFbzBllccGzy2svLCol3ioVHTyUBNyDzLm6DznCjdDfcdFN0WFwb8HkOGKWgtLHy9VlOcRHOxljvPo3vQMpk_BFfOw5Ieb55Bm65vLqTXGXlX3oEhqjEO7GTrmxXQol7M-eqgxHRZzVmwOXTw3kn2_5Awz_e4pOsAWjgQMkO5Xe233UMpjlH35eWL4oTi0X1df4YGvrEiXImlhxBnWM-bSK5dWRXZTLf5Ik7xDPzH6Sq7tpFCNVHGKxswAnoiXs8KQbPY34eRX4Mqp8nluEQzCRD15J8QPYDP1tTdbhX99sLlU_hjVDu7sXDJoFqQ/44t/oVLf5CPGTSmkWMb0SwvhCg/h3/h001.EnlkNNAwvZmqbyT0gaeLYRtGYyOeDUfe0ogXgZ6144U), wouldn’t dare vote because they face stiff penalties.
Not true.
Our federal laws are full of [alien voter loopholes](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4reQG6metMTPwZYb7HrQzwxxNfeZiGfG6EOSX4h6aywV274zgqWut6xBrRwuudBozV-y_mIh2LfQ8qTeEs2GbsNxM5rVclY_6a2YKh2946KdFdc9jJ0YWge8CS_nWXeZ5vAeDhmFwRlvTKp-3uWm5UeRPmvxxB99wYEALkeJZ-yiWviAmsCd2L6KPXWdTrLz9ZNHJqCwXyzbNmtk1aKds7E/44t/oVLf5CPGTSmkWMb0SwvhCg/h4/h001.tN7-AiWyG37YlyWeCsgkY5pD-bnoe1QcVIQihFcCmDo) that create ambiguity where there should be none. More loopholes in interagency databases ensure that states cannot effectively determine a voter’s eligibility on the basis of citizenship. Together, these laws and processes create a throughway for election fraud, hidden in plain sight, with no recourse.
America cannot wait around to see whether the implosion of our borders will be exploited in the general election. It’s happening now. Post-election damage control won’t work.
[If we go to court, will you stand with us?](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOTNGTUOPEh_1Wy0Sryl80lDi2A-sg903k-MdJamUcnNTUcAnQtgc2gONrzIzE98vWbgogWqc5BsQCSzHiSliVZQ/44t/oVLf5CPGTSmkWMb0SwvhCg/h5/h001.4h7ROmXKOQ-O7loTRQ7ORfvDh7oFOL5dtNORjP7hETs)
Our legal team is drafting arguments for litigation. Our research team is amassing evidence from across the country. Both endeavors are extremely expensive.
Here’s one small example of what must be gathered: We asked the state of Georgia for material used to support their [Citizenship Audit](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.TU_iQSc-VH56ogpHwV_IfkosRJaFKo5zqnzlTwR13osepmr7QB6teK8gtzBarGbTsMRCHwI39p2trCP0oN_VqtmUbyEKUIYqu0a5WXoiJ5iH6qTkH6RWT8FmUUnttiRxljV7qKxW147XahVbt2gj0r5_9qMACwfMDsYyKZPGn2xd-MQAq4qoemjW0p7SL7GZ4nFRaNQ_HWnuiJY-JuGYov7Eg8jbrtE9PFpbaeZNOsadc2Cl6UYSjhLcog0UTPIsokiigg0MBNGCI1DGRxA8gWyRMhVcC6Y4sVtzyAXNv_C6G2rA5ZfdIZ2pg1rZIewFeTIBFvrsdAUZQsRdF2nv2MbL4cdnbYjK7PjgTi1nMMF5WksQ6efRKxzyTOVrBaGrp1q3XFZ3cAaDtFg_uwP0c5-Jm0d0So8C-SpK4-aF2hMDtAa0XbT8ASM4bntPWZsj/44t/oVLf5CPGTSmkWMb0SwvhCg/h6/h001.7zMLgzkH5YIY5q6rE6QaKGMxQ_XAUhslp9mdRFTNwT0), which they promoted heavily in 2022 and 2023 (we conceptually agree with them, btw, we just wanted to understand how they conducted the audit).
Knowing there is no comprehensive dataset provided to states to help determine voter eligibility on the basis of non-citizenship, we are curious to understand how Georgia managed the feat.
Shown below is a copy of our open records request letter to the Georgia Sec. of State, which contains a copy of their emailed response. Bottom line, they want six months and $7500 to send us their Citizenship Audit information. This is the kind of uphill battle we face, but so be it.
|
---
Open records requests are being sent to every state and the largest 200 counties, asking each to provide their process for citizenship eligibility verification.
From compelling video evidence and examples of undocumented voters’ voting, to the unreliability of registration processes, and failure of federal standards to secure our elections - once you see it laid out, it’s hard to deny the orchestration.
The lawsuit effort will cost millions. We need to build a war chest as quickly as possible. To that end, we are posting links to our donation page, and also announcing a new fundraiser on Give, Send, Go.

We must not stand by and watch it happen again. Thank you for your steadfast commitment to the cause of trustworthy elections.
Never quit.
Ever onward-

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Urgent Action Needed
body:
highlight-blue {background-color: #648fc6;}
In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles

|
---
| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhcovckng8j8re4d1mtc56cr652tc89v2gfht3so_rp22sh2s8i6ep30cjhm8oj4clh2bs) For Life,
Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America
---

---

By Illinois Review

On Tuesday, President Donald Trump dominated Illinois’ Primary night, winning in a landslide as Trump delegates cruised to easy victories, solidifying his status as the leader of the national Republican Party.

With 92 percent of the vote counted, Trump leads with over 80 percent, while Nikki Haley sits at 14 percent and Ron DeSantis at just 2 percent.

Shortly after the polls closed, Trump posted a message on his Truth Social account, writing, “THANK YOU, ILLINOIS – MAGA!”

Trump delegates also had an impressive showing, dominating election night alongside the 45th President of the United States. In the 6th District, Trump Delegate candidate Scott Kaspar – IR’s General Counsel, led the pack with 25,917 votes. Kathleen Abbate, another Trump Delegate was also at the top of the board with 25,772 votes and Joyce Hebein rounded out the delegate ticket with 24,006 votes.

A coalition of international aid groups is warning that famine is imminent

and some are even killed by the IDF in what are being called ‘flour

Growing up, my family was bankrupted by medical bills. Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to stand up for paycheck-to-paycheck families like mine.
#
Peter,
This is the worst fear for every family living paycheck-to-paycheck in our country: **_Something_ happens, and you lose everything.** I know because I lived it.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44642?refcode=em20240320-5089&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5089%2E614464%2EHucOaC)
For my family, that fear became a reality when my little sister was born with a heart condition that required surgeries at a hospital over 100 miles away from home.
Within months, my parents were bankrupted by medical bills.
We relied on the generosity of our community to make it through that time. Friends, neighbors, members of our church — everyday people who had no more than we did, taking care of each other when times got tough.
That’s something Josh Hawley could never understand.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because working Missouri families shouldn’t have to live in fear.** I know what that’s like — and I’m ready to fight like hell to make sure families like the ones in my old neighborhood have the resources they need to build strong, healthy, and secure lives all across our state.
**[So if you’re with me, will you please consider adding a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford to my grassroots campaign today? clean_body: Growing up, my family was bankrupted by medical bills. Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to stand up for paycheck-to-paycheck families like mine. Peter, This is the worst fear for every family living paycheck-to-paycheck in our country: Something happens, and you lose everything. I know because I lived it. For my family, that fear became a reality when my little sister was born with a heart condition that required surgeries at a hospital over 100 miles away from home. Within months, my parents were bankrupted by medical bills. We relied on the generosity of our community to make it through that time. Friends, neighbors, members of our church — everyday people who had no more than we did, taking care of each other when times got tough. That’s something Josh Hawley could never understand. I’m running for U.S. Senate because working Missouri families shouldn’t have to live in fear. I know what that’s like — and I’m ready to fight like hell to make sure families like the ones in my old neighborhood have the resources they need to build strong, healthy, and secure lives all across our state. body:
Starting the journey to an Indigenous-owned visitor gateway

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81324372/462095581/-1245812088?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-orew&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjYzBhNTRiLWRiZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VvTJJi3-GrgAfECEiql0J4QtJfByIur0D4V5abjbGAE=&emci=a069324c-89e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=1cc0a54b-dbe6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=1504551)
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81324373/462095582/-1245812088?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-orew&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjYzBhNTRiLWRiZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VvTJJi3-GrgAfECEiql0J4QtJfByIur0D4V5abjbGAE=&emci=a069324c-89e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=1cc0a54b-dbe6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=1504551)
| | Dear Peter,
---
This is a historic moment and we want you to be one of the first people to hear about this exciting and hopeful vision in the redwood forest.

Yesterday, we took historic first steps towards creating [**‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81324374/462095583/-1245812088?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-orew&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjYzBhNTRiLWRiZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VvTJJi3-GrgAfECEiql0J4QtJfByIur0D4V5abjbGAE=&emci=a069324c-89e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=1cc0a54b-dbe6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=1504551), a remarkable connector to Redwood National and State Parks that will provide opportunities to explore living Indigenous culture and spectacular redwood groves. Yesterday we signed a landmark agreement with our partners, the Yurok Tribe, National Park Service, and California State Parks, describing this exciting vision and our shared commitment to transfer the ‘O Rew property from the League back to its original stewards, the Yurok Tribe.

“We acknowledge and celebrate the opportunity to return Indigenous guardianship to ‘O Rew and reimagine how millions of visitors from around the world experience the redwoods,” said **Sam Hodder** , president and CEO of Save the Redwoods League. “This agreement starts the process of changing the narrative about how, by whom, and for whom we steward natural lands.”

The vision for ‘O Rew represents a groundbreaking conservation model—a first-ever arrangement in which the National Park Service and California State Parks would support management and public visitation on land owned and permanently protected by the Yurok Tribe. We are so excited to innovate and build this model with our partners at the doorstep to a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81324375/462095584/-1245812088?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-orew&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjYzBhNTRiLWRiZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VvTJJi3-GrgAfECEiql0J4QtJfByIur0D4V5abjbGAE=&emci=a069324c-89e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=1cc0a54b-dbe6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=1504551)
‘O Rew encompasses 125 acres of ecologically significant land just outside Orick, California, surrounded by some of the largest remaining old-growth redwood groves in the world. This was once the degraded site of the Orick sawmill, until a five-year, $23 million restoration project—spearheaded by the League, California Trout, the Yurok Tribe, and other local partners—revived the section of Prairie Creek that runs through the property. Young coho and Chinook salmon, steelhead trout, and other wildlife are already reaping the benefits.

Our vision for ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway builds on this ecological success story, with plenty of important and meaningful work to do before the 2026 transfer. Right now, we are focused on a $9 million project to construct robust visitor amenities, engaging interpretive displays, and new hiking trails—including a connection to the spectacular Lady Bird Johnson Grove. We’ve identified $7 million in support, and we are currently raising the remaining $2 million needed to complete this incredible site transformation.

With our partners and your ongoing commitment, we can achieve this shared vision for [**‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81324376/462095585/-1245812088?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-orew&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFjYzBhNTRiLWRiZTYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=VvTJJi3-GrgAfECEiql0J4QtJfByIur0D4V5abjbGAE=&emci=a069324c-89e5-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=1cc0a54b-dbe6-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=1504551), giving people from near and far the opportunity to experience the ancient redwoods through the lens of Indigenous culture.

It is a pleasure to announce this bold vision to you. This is just the beginning, and we look forward to sharing more about this exciting project.
---

_I vow that this RNC will be the most powerful election-winning machine in American history._

Are you with me on this? We could really use your support right now.
