I’m a born-and-raised Missourian who watched with horror when Josh Hawley raised his fist at insurrectionists outside the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, then ran out the back door when they stormed the building later that day.

I’ve seen communities across my home state torn apart because of cowardly politicians like him — and I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
**[So before I ask you to split a donation of $5 or whatever you can today between my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign and Jacky Rosen to replace Josh Hawley, please let me tell you why:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81325323/462098891/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3596-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTY5NzViMS1kY2U2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WdGCZU2xkrk04etXxfjVOu3InF1Z7txnxPRTta_R7I4=)**

Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.

While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**

Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.

What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it earlier this year:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81325325/462098893/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3596-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTY5NzViMS1kY2U2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WdGCZU2xkrk04etXxfjVOu3InF1Z7txnxPRTta_R7I4=)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.

Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.

Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.
So friend, if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it. **[But if you want someone to show you real courage, please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate by splitting a donation of $5 between his campaign and Jacky Rosen today. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81325326/462098894/106945853?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk3596-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTY5NzViMS1kY2U2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WdGCZU2xkrk04etXxfjVOu3InF1Z7txnxPRTta_R7I4=)**

Peter, it's official: the general election is here!

Polls show this race is neck and neck, Republicans are already spending record-breaking sums to defeat me and flip the Senate red, and it's only going to get worse.
**[So I'm personally asking: Will you split $5 or more right now between my campaign and Bob Casey’s to make sure we have the resources to fight back against GOP attacks, protect this seat, and keep the Senate blue?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240320-2?refcode=em20240320-2&refcode2=2392_552475_ZyDe1p&akid=2392%2E552475%2EZyDe1p)**

name: Sara (personal)
subject: Good news
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
You’ve probably heard that quote from Mister Rogers about “looking for the helpers” – the idea that when things are tough, it can be heartening to look around and notice all the people who are helping solve the problem.
I think the same thing applies to looking for good news. In a media landscape that tends to hype up the worst case scenarios and feed on our fears, it’s worth taking a moment to focus on the good things that are happening all around us.
Because I can promise you this – there are good things happening. Flowers are blooming (hello, cherry blossom season in DC 🌸), cute babies are being born, young people are finding their voice and their way in the world.
I want to be clear: Of course pretty flowers don’t counteract the very real challenges and hardships in our country and across the world. There is no trivializing global human rights atrocities or threats to our foundational rights here at home.
But we need connection, we need good news, and we need joy – especially when the world is demanding our attention and energy to resist and fight back.
Not to sound overly sappy, but I think it’s true that hope is the path to progress.
So I want to know: What’s your good news? What are you seeing or feeling that’s bringing you small (or big!) joy?
I hope you’ll reply to this email and share your thoughts with me and my team.
Together, we can not only remind one another to look for the good – we can also create the good.
Thanks, and talk soon.
-Sara

clean_body: [] Friends, You’ve probably heard that quote from Mister Rogers about “looking for the helpers” – the idea that when things are tough, it can be heartening to look around and notice all the people who are helping solve the problem. I think the same thing applies to looking for good news. In a media landscape that tends to hype up the worst case scenarios and feed on our fears, it’s worth taking a moment to focus on the good things that are happening all around us. Because I can promise you this – there are good things happening. Flowers are blooming (hello, cherry blossom season in DC 🌸), cute babies are being born, young people are finding their voice and their way in the world. I want to be clear: Of course pretty flowers don’t counteract the very real challenges and hardships in our country and across the world. There is no trivializing global human rights atrocities or threats to our foundational rights here at home. But we need connection, we need good news, and we need joy – especially when the world is demanding our attention and energy to resist and fight back. Not to sound overly sappy, but I think it’s true that hope is the path to progress. So I want to know: What’s your good news? What are you seeing or feeling that’s bringing you small (or big!) joy? I hope you’ll reply to this email and share your thoughts with me and my team. Together, we can not only remind one another to look for the good – we can also create the good. name: Rudy Salas
subject: I’m running. Join me. Let’s finish the job.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
Friend,
It's Rudy Salas. I’m the Democrat running to flip California's 22nd Congressional District and defeat my extremist opponent David Valadao.
We fought hard to flip this seat last November. **With your help, we almost did it.**
Our campaign came closer than any Democratic challenger in the entire state to flipping a red seat. We were just a few points short, and that was despite Kevin McCarthy's super PAC allies spending **$16 million** against us.
Winning back the House majority runs through CA-22, and I intend to finish what we started. But I can't do this alone. If we're going to win, I'll need your help in standing up for American Democracy and protecting our rights.
**[Please, can you chip in $5 to my campaign and The Long Run ahead of my FEC fundraising deadline on March 31st?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.CbYKSs&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=1&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between Rudy Salas and The Long Run immediately:_
[Express Donate: $5](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1281?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.-eyaNL&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=20&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split._xcsJ7&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=21&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.H3Wd88&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=22&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.yv6sVy&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=23&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.nN92Rt&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=24&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.CbYKSs&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=25&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
The Central Valley is my home, and it's been the honor of my lifetime to serve the community that raised me.
Twelve years ago, I made history when I became the first Latino elected to Bakersfield's City Council and with your help, we will make history again by becoming the first Latino from the Central Valley to serve in Congress.
During my five terms in the California State Legislature, we brought down costs for seniors, passed overtime pay for farmworkers, invested in our children and made drinking water safer for our communities.
**My opponent David Valadao and his party bosses in Washington are making life harder for families in CA-22.** At a time when costs are rising, Valadao is currently voting the party line to raise health care costs, cutting “meals on wheels” for seniors and cutting veterans' benefits. While our freedom rights as Americans are under attack in the Supreme Court, Valadao is a co-author on legislation for a national abortion ban, even if a woman is raped.
**We deserve better.** The Central Valley is the beating heart of our state, and we deserve someone who will do what’s right for America and Central Valley families. I'd be honored to have your support on day one.
**[With national Republicans committed to defeating us, winning will take widespread, grassroots support. I’m counting on you to be a part of this effort. Can you chip in $5 today?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.CbYKSs&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=26&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-salas-split.CbYKSs&refcode=em24320-1-tt&t=27&akid=5247%2E196590%2ElUjiPD)
With appreciation,
Rudy

We hope to see you there!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.HV-T5b9C6Y6Pisqo-P4PmwBtZ_GxELuT586x3F0HSfdXQBEvJhR8nHlCRw2HHQH4qgpJaSkqAqWaOJMZqbdrwXPngXxVopV0I8oMwJMFQdAGs177mLvrmu5s4ByU3wFRsK37Qkc8lDCop3SynV2_c1qnWTicZuz734dXzg-5v1UcFZauBwRz_dXO-Wa9hi53REJMLVv1Kz0lt4QzZ7t9PuLQVdPs-i7bfvRltWwUklKxzP2NvYBu3F8oQpTaFSbmZrwPqHm8hxoiZ-YDq5b7s70RmA-IsJZgxmi0N0vZ7UkOkK97mfA9EHIMJjr2lR8w9aDKxRjQYxgV6Z1THa4lqkrebrFBYYpOBSmwn5bQis4zbbEJm-hPSNbis7RD5G2ifA4m6oHcmF3m_4UZlSHCYCv8oM1UyO7nBEbp4lWMTwsz0JllroXpRLRQ6RhfbVLq/44t/LPITCrY_RZmNqD9iyeguDg/h0/h001.p9lRUAwLemxSol0VPL910_z9lgZWKNPgS8AGIhvNVJk)
Hi Peter, I’m Roohi, the Biden-Harris 2024 National Organizing Director! When Campaign Manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez asked me to join this fight to reelect Joe and Kamala, I couldn’t say yes fast enough. **Let me tell you why.** This year, organizing is not just an important part of our campaign’s strategy -- it’s central to getting out President Biden and Vice President Harris’s story of progress. In 2020, volunteers across the country had conversations with voters, reached out to key communities, and empowered folks to take action, all from their living rooms and kitchen tables. That kind of collective power is even more essential this year, in an election that will determine the future of our democracy and fundamental freedoms. As the first LGBTQ person and first woman of color in this role, this election is deeply personal to me. I grew up in community organizing, where you can’t just turn away from your neighbor or city official -- you have to face every campaign and every election, from school board races to federal elections, with empathy and understanding. **Because empathy wins races and builds power.** There are no two people more empathetic than Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. name: Hill Harper
subject: This is for my son…
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
And every Michigan family.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1104%2E62735%2EejCwXq)
I was scrolling through my photos last night, and I just had to share this one, Peter:
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/790?t=2&akid=1104%2E62735%2EejCwXq)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/790?t=3&akid=1104%2E62735%2EejCwXq)**
It’s one of my all-time favorites from the campaign trail: my son Pierce, perched up on my shoulders (one of his favorite places to be), during the historic United Auto Workers strike last year.
As a single father, my whole world revolves around Pierce. Adopting him is the single greatest decision I ever made — his laughter is my joy, his dreams are my aspirations, and his future is my driving motivation. Every morning I drop him off at school, I’m reminded of the responsibility I bear as his father to shape a world that nurtures, protects, and empowers him to be his best self.
**Peter, I truly believe in a better Michigan — and I’m running for U.S. Senate to deliver it not just for my own son, but _your_ kids, too. **
I want them to grow up in a world where healthcare is a fundamental human right, where workers are treated with dignity, and where the toxic influence of money in politics is overpowered by the will of the people. Their collective future hinges on the decisions we make today, and I can promise you: As Michigan’s next Senator, I’ll make every decision, every vote, with our kids’ futures in mind. I’ll fight like hell and work with Democrats, Republicans, Independents — whoever it takes — to deliver progress on the issues you care about.
**_But I can’t do it alone._**
[**We have less than five months until the primary, and it’s going to take ALL of us working together to win this election. So, I have to ask: Will you please chip in $5 _today_ to fuel our people-powered campaign?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/792?t=5&akid=1104%2E62735%2EejCwXq)
_If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

Hill Harper

subject: 9.3 million more people would have voted.

body:
| | | | | [](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=565bf3caab&e=95417d7e87)
---
Fellow activist,

In a recent study released by the _Brennan Center for Justice_ , they found that, since the Supreme Court overturned key parts of the federal Voting Rights Act, the gap in turnout rates between white and nonwhite voters “**grew almost twice as quickly** in formerly covered jurisdictions as in other parts of the country with similar demographic and socioeconomic profiles.”

The Voting Rights Act protected voters against racial discrimination. For example, counties with a history of racial discrimination were required to obtain permission from the Justice Department before changing voting laws. But the Supreme Court decided that discrimination at the polls “no longer existed,” thus, protections were unnecessary. 🙄

As a result, state legislatures across the country quickly passed extreme barriers to voting with the intention of silencing Black and brown voters. This included new voter ID laws, purging hundreds of thousands of names from voter rolls, eliminating drop boxes, and more.

According to the New York Times, the study found that if nonwhite voters had participated at the same rate as white voters during the 2020 election, **__9.3 million more people would have voted.__** And in the 2022 midterms, that total would have been 13.9 million ballots.

**It’s clear: discrimination at the polls is having a __crushing__ impact on our democracy.**

[**NPP is fighting to ensure that all Pennsylvanianians eligible to vote, especially Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities, and the youth (17-35-year-olds), have equitable access to the ballot box and are able to make their voices heard in every election, twice a year. We are through game one of the double header. The voters have spoken, and they chose me to be the Republican candidate for Senate in California. There’s no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it’s so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." # Host Committee Happenings
A Newsletter by the Chicago 2024 Host Committee
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
## Note from the Host Committee
Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings, our biweekly newsletter! We are exactly 5 months away from this year’s Democratic National Convention.
| | | | | | | | | Last weekend, we were delighted to participate in the St. Patrick’s Day parade and watch the Plumbers Local 130 dye the Chicago River green!
Convention planning is in full swing, so be sure to keep reading for the latest ways to get involved.
---
|
---
In case you missed it, we are hosting a vendor fair for arena operations this Thursday, March 21. You can [RSVP here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ba9056e6b5&e=e789b9d47e) to attend either in-person or online. More information about the summit can be found below!
| | | | | | | | | As always, our team is available to assist you at [info@chicago2024.com](mailto:info@chicago2024.com).
---
|
---
## Visiting Women-owned Businesses In Andersonville!
On Monday, we joined Governor JB Pritzker, Lt. Governor Juliana Stratton, Congresswoman Jan Schakowsky, and Laura Austin, Executive Director of the Andersonville Chamber of Commerce for a trip up to the Andersonville neighborhood in the **Edgewater** community area. Andersonville has a large Swedish community and one the biggest LGBTQ+ populations in the city. We toured a few of the women-owned businesses available in the DNC vendor directory and enjoyed some delicious treats at the Swedish American Museum. On your next trip to Andersonville make sure you:
| | | | | | | | |
* **Explore** the [Swedish American Museum](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a000cdbf5c&e=e789b9d47e)
* **Check out**[Nobody’s Darling](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=393cf5c29d&e=e789b9d47e), a Black, queer, women-owned bar with award-winning cocktails.
* **Shop** at [Ándale Market](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1a94d7b42e&e=e789b9d47e) for daily essentials, unique foods, local and imported goods, gifts, and more.
* **Eat** at [Uvae Kitchen and Wine Bar](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=1815736852&e=e789b9d47e), for the perfect wine paired food or sign up for one of their tasting classes!

---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=f0b5dcce10&e=e789b9d47e)
---
Check out CBS2 Chicago's exclusive coverage of our tour [here](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e330cf73a9&e=e789b9d47e)!
|
---
## Arena Operations:
## Construction and Expo Services Summit
Tomorrow, March 21 we are hosting our first vendor summit for Arena Operations at the United Center. Join prime contractors and industry leaders for exclusive networking opportunities and a chance to explore exciting partnerships for the Democratic National Convention.
This event will focus on Arena Operations such as the ones listed below:

## 77 Spotlight
In honor of Women’s History Month, we are spotlighting community areas that are the birthplace of some of Chicago’s most famous women. This week, we’re traveling to **Forest Glen** and the **South Shore**.
**Forest Glen** is a neighborhood located on the Northwest side of Chicago that has a rich history. It consists of several smaller neighborhoods, including Edgebrook, Sauganash, Wildwood, and Forest Glen, each with distinct architectural styles. This community is a hidden gem featuring forests, rolling hills, and winding streets that follow the Chicago River. Chicago's first woman mayor, **Jane Byrne** , lived in the Sauganash neighborhood.
**Explore** the [Forest Glen Woods](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=762fb23859&e=e789b9d47e) and its numerous biking and hiking trails.
**Start** your morning with breakfast and coffee at [Edgebrook Coffee Shop](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=e5433168df&e=e789b9d47e), a local favorite.
**Eat** at [King Pho](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=d6c5582f1d&e=e789b9d47e) for some authentic Vietnamese food!
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
_Credit: Alejandro Reyes_
In Chicago’s South Side, we're shining a light on the **South Shore** neighborhood. This community area is located along the picturesque Lake Michigan shoreline and spans from 67th to 79th Streets. It's known for its [Bungalow Belt](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=96c18d336c&e=e789b9d47e), the largest beaches in the city, and beautiful architecture. The South Shore neighborhood was also home to many famous Chicago women such as **Michelle Obama, Carol Moseley Braun, and Suze Orman**.
**Explore** the first and only African American children’s museum in the country, the [Bronzeville Children’s Museum](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=94f8c9134f&e=e789b9d47e).
**Catch** a show at E[ta Creative Arts Foundation](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=37d22cf22c&e=e789b9d47e), a performing arts center that’s been showcasing Black culture for over 50 years.
**Check out** [Rainbow Beach Park](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a10903c9bb&e=e789b9d47e) for the best view of Chicago's skyline. Another must-see destination is the [South Shore Cultural Center](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=bcc0d7113f&e=e789b9d47e) (formerly South Shore Country Club), which is a Chicago landmark encompassing 65 acres of lakefront green space.
**Eat** at [Majani Soulful Vegan](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=ec47bfe192&e=e789b9d47e). Here, you'll find plant-based southern cuisine inspired by Chefs Tsadakeeyah and Nasya Emmanuel’s favorite family recipes.

## Vendor Spotlights
This month, we’re recognizing **women-owned businesses** across Chicago.
| | | | | | | | | [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0dfe4d5da5&e=e789b9d47e)
---
|
---
[Freeman Pictures, Inc.](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=2034232a36&e=e789b9d47e), is an Illinois-based, woman-owned business providing video and still photography production for government agencies, corporations, nonprofits and educational institutions. With 25+ years of experience, they have created work for the City of Chicago, the State of Illinois, Cook County, and many Fortune 500 corporations. They pride themselves on creating media that makes a human connection.
| [Ms. P's Gluten Free](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=5987bb7c20&e=e789b9d47e) is a Black- and woman-owned business. The founder and CEO, Lisa Marsh, wants to nourish communities and help people live long, happy, flavorful lives. Ms. P's Gluten Free offers a range of delicious and healthy gluten-free products that are sure to satisfy your taste buds. Find them at Whole Foods Markets, Mariano’s, and Fresh Thyme on North Elston, as well as the Community Fresh Market on 63rd and Racine!
---
[](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=0fb12c89cd&e=e789b9d47e)
| | | | | | | | | [Kamehachi](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=a425c91ff3&e=e789b9d47e) is a family-owned Japanese restaurant that has served delicious sushi for over 40 years. The restaurant was originally opened by Mrs. Marion Konishi in the **Old Town** neighborhood and is now co-owned by her daughter, Sharon Perazzoli, and granddaughter, Giulia Sindler, who have successfully expanded the family business.
---
| [](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=24e81968aa&e=e789b9d47e)
---
The name "Kamehachi," which means "eight turtles" in Japanese, is a symbol of good luck and long life, making this restaurant a true gem in the heart of Chicago.

## Staff Spotlight
This week we are spotlighting **Avigail (Avi) Bailon,** our Deputy Operations Director.
| | | | | | | | | Avi is a resident of Cicero, where she grew up and continues to live. She joined the Host Committee with a goal to promote engagement across the city. When she's not working, Avi enjoys bouldering and spending time with her two cats and dog. She is a huge fan of La Iguanita, a restaurant in Brighton Park. One of her favorite Chicago activities is kayaking on the river!

I know you're as grateful as I am for the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. But I'm also concerned that the pro-life movement will mistakenly think this ruling means the fight is won. **Today, I 'd like to invite you to join thousands of others who believe the sanctity of life is worth defending by adding your name to the pledge I have linked below:**

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8477775ab5a840e6bf4ef650c049c582&_e=IeWz-P4kG3f3NN6GPzTTK28W7RS6fac_l2iR5xW19K0OUiB82oPu2CD_RA_nwZUjp29zJqxzSKAXtUjqFU9pL4zwlRFy0VZEip5GGH4sLNQ_IGXazItSyxnQojWeO7DQV0xRCxfe8kuaLDf9FAJeEVs9bgq1iPUoDclExd70Rsc-fc85-kYodGiVdNcpdm7sfHS5PxK0RSz5VfeTsvsbOV9bW1TjDYkcoAS7TDsccFeYx64dlpzRGPqB50D9AenSgSGC18nVJjzymi57YAxjaVLYQlQ29_fD68LpTUJVFJiWBTY4lgH8eJfjzcueziSefpsXFtuIbTWIrAvKU-YQHmQDgPTD7wvV4p85_gaR2yrp7V6IpziijLhwT3j6iCqofFxIs5GN6LjK-y2SmlVvKw8xyy6pZvi_X4_xA0pLqgA%3D)

[**Will you take a minute to stand with me by signing this pledge now?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8477775ab5a840e6bf4ef650c049c582&_e=IeWz-P4kG3f3NN6GPzTTK28W7RS6fac_l2iR5xW19K0OUiB82oPu2CD_RA_nwZUjp29zJqxzSKAXtUjqFU9pL4zwlRFy0VZEip5GGH4sLNQ_IGXazItSyxnQojWeO7DQV0xRCxfe8kuaLDf9FAJeEVs9bgq1iPUoDclExd70Rsc-fc85-kYodGiVdNcpdm7sfHS5PxK0RSz5VfeTsvsbOV9bW1TjDYkcoAS7TDsccFeYx64dlpzRGPqB50D9AenSM1oAn98c51E8Qc91aLd3IPAu4XB3wrhB8eRL14pJp-tR3FnBcIcVLSjP2XabW6F-MG3ERaZqfRmFmGRnduyMY4eTCR08ybIHhihhqO3DlJZmf3-NosxP2lbbvZappzi5LL5X2Kl_0zcnZoJll40geR3LL0GEbhOY6dxCKm_0V3o%3D)

_Hi Peter, this is Mazie. I need to share this important message from my dear friend and colleague, Sherrod Brown, who just won the Democratic nomination for US Senate in Ohio. He will be facing an extreme, Trump-backed opponent in the general election, Bernie Moreno. Please split a donation between our campaigns if you’re able today to keep Sherrod and his pro-worker agenda in the Senate._
* * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81335953/462127829/-1755529737?amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240320_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjRhMTgyNy1lZWU2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ctErfGgO0H7u-lHWsv8uGA4Sooyz1GRocVckPRZiUvw=) Peter, it's official: the general election is here! **I couldn't be more honored to represent the people of Ohio and have the opportunity to keep fighting for the Dignity of Work in the Senate. I want to personally thank every member of this team — including you, Peter — for powering our grassroots movement this far.** All we have accomplished together so far makes it clearer than ever, Ohio voters want someone who will fight for them in the Senate. Better wages and working conditions, reproductive freedom, affordable housing and health care — I promise to keep up these critical fights for all of us. But our real fight starts now, friend. We now have an official opponent, Bernie Moreno, and he's a deep-pocketed Donald Trump ally that's ready to spend millions of dollars to try to buy this seat. Polls show this race is neck and neck, Republicans are already spending record-breaking sums to defeat me and flip the Senate red, and it's only going to get worse. **So I'm personally asking:[Will you split $10 or more right now between my campaign and Mazie’s to make sure we have the resources to fight back against GOP attacks, protect this seat, and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81335954/462127830/-1755529737?amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240320_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjRhMTgyNy1lZWU2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ctErfGgO0H7u-lHWsv8uGA4Sooyz1GRocVckPRZiUvw=)** You're the reason we have made it this far — and you're the reason why we'll do it again in November. name: Patti Reilly
subject: The anti-police mob is putting my son in jail
body:
I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6fbhNuJbX07Zvl8OtjsY9mCRHtxcHQ_AvS6nT_Yu-pWiMjDc4BW3FowBMyWLAa2shihg_NI0W2xr9RGL5l85FfHr4O__UpGvr4c9urqmAZj3U8TvwLxu84ciWSXooT2Nsf8-0sWvP3fXxUarTl-pZs1VBKBqNrODg0Hp_4b7orpF)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6XQfmnyn-P88Wt3NSf87MU033tBdpTyneyLuuBOUpQmEUlFXqc6HrGoMXnW6Z90eRFYckqCcHWNDkRtEWyVuzLXx9hBFVfVWJ2sad5BJNCRn2QLcTUmyg3Rg0AzLzGvc-TWVTI1zUALd3mIt6czzKmXEerebAGQXKRpJ2dM487fE)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6ThIO9xOIoaZFc4rZ1s60pQKqVfUord_ADQEaSQA8e93SdQYcgqw7VexFxWqLD7fBxoL6Co6BO0NWULk-WrwvStk0J3OBUzKOrTaT0qhbl6_AWb8oJ4BwDl57sZVSma6m9G3gVtR6XZOymAmkMLLke3RWVmhNUlCngJn5b_6gkO0)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6T8lLwEtk1CD5ppnno9SWvf0TPfJUIS3i8iVVts9I1Mi5pnm6DQ1zX5-WVazsZLtwWhGsL3NBOjJSjVodS3X8vdpUP160V2mrddYhAA_fyUvmjogAlgQRyYzYzNDcW5_zHghBR-4yOg4FQ2qNEDwhyzH_G0yG-kaLxGSDYw7m0Y4)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6b1rKuV3G9IVNCQHPXlGdubkJsKVQhrd0ffTYO0mg3WIwgBH9-X-PlkSIUC_bAk0JlftqLZZHKjKpZO3Lq1lAF1D3NqY420Cgya7pMvnqyZe7mUw1zOxh4JENc5Vzqhpc0Mb__ndoqUyjWD5o1ZOUT5yJCgra-3p27hJpKMazHMK)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff01eb2f5f1d45c98d7432fdc627bdff&_e=IJcJn3cStlk4DSflQV9vkF6k5sgqD5CknGoAWcG3n7J9xUXHUNmqgl02FUT81zHrHHfit7TcIjttD5kiabycL5k54oQal9vX2pGdTTStV3UC3WiT2LWzS4tJm6-20C9joOUBF9N0Qi_tCVJJ7GKLvrrXcY5OYMDBW9nQFLwY5_IzhFJo0v4vw3kzYDiGoFCVlgyB0CHYoRcJ2192fVbZ6XWC_7bMMyWPEa4NK83Yl8jENP6Wzc-T_VzPyLIWSM1H1HorhEok_KxD1Nut43MQT9DlydJPfq3DECx7RO_lnixBHVgrcn2IXc3hNCBHJVJdDkxBDnCl6iQ-tMMTTFLdpwZvk5VSv3VuO2n74hbCRW8lvcV_6Pk6yb6pecm7lFii)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder - murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch. The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, I wouldn 't even believe it. - but first, let me explain what happened. Our nightmare started in October of 2020. Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory. Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge. So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter. Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs. My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car. And then it happened. Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car. After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn... Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy. They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist. There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires. Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death. The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder. When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own. He chose to run from the cops. He chose to not wear a helmet. He chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going. So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to sixty years in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began. You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense. The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang... They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before... They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg... And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash. Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence " guilty." He's currently awaiting sentencing. Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear. My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year! And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free... ...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he didn 't do. I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund -or LELDF for short. If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment. Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence. So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone: To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left. If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help. But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now. I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me. Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly. Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive. Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today. And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence. Sincerely, Patti Reilly P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart. More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visitwww.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue Lives Matter! **Here are the facts:** California’s mail-in ballots are not “unlimited” — they are limited to one for every registered California voter. Every ballot has a known destination — its assigned voter’s address on their voter registration. Every registered voter can only vote once (but on every ballot this year, the California U.S. Senate seat appears TWICE). Every ballot must be postmarked by Election Day. Peter — Earlier this month, Oregon legislators concluded their 2024 legislative session, making progress on critical issues – including housing and homelessness, summer learning, the state’s addiction crisis, campaign finance reform, and more. Governor Kotek is excited that lawmakers approved her housing production legislation, which will now help make housing in the state more available and affordable. The legislature also took action to increase educational support for students this summer and implement campaign finance reforms with bipartisan support. Vince was my dog from 2011 to 2021, when he passed away from old age. And what bonded us most is we were both scrappy underdogs.
Vince Neil was rescued on the side of the road, likely after living in the woods for years. We called him a "retired cowboy" because of it. One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew.
I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college.
Vince and I both managed to find stability and a comfortable life as adults. **But in this race, I'm still the scrappy underdog.**
I'm up against a well-connected incumbent who rode his brother's coattails, takes money from corporate PACs (I don't), and rolls over for MAGA in the hopes it keeps him in power.
[If you believe we need more underdogs and fewer pampered show dogs in Congress, please pitch in $10 or more to my campaign. Friend, it’s Sen. Brad Pfaff.
Like so many of us, I grew up on a small family farm.
That history is important to me, and as your State Senator, I continue to fight so hard for family farmers and other working Wisconsinites.
Before I get into it, Friend, I’m going to be honest. There is a lot more I want to do to help Wisconsinites, but I need the support of a united coalition to help me defeat my far–right opponent. Can I count on you to join my team? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240320_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]

After Republican politicians removed me from my post as Wisconsin’s Secretary of Agriculture for standing up for small farmers, I told the Wisconsin Examiner that my mother used to repeat:
“‘Brad, you were given two ears and one mouth for a reason. Listen, twice as much as you speak.’”
And I never forgot this.
As I travel the state to talk to farmers, rural residents, and small business owners, I not only listened to them, I heard them. And the devastating reality I heard being repeated over and over was this: our state government was leaving them behind.
I am proud of what I’ve been able to accomplish with your support but there’s so much more I need to do to 1️⃣support our small farmers, 2️⃣repair our roads and expand broadband access, and 3️⃣expand health care coverage for all.
And the key to doing all this? Keeping my seat.
Friend, my far–right Republican opponent has no interest in standing up for working Wisconsinites and small farmers and is planning on undoing all the progress we’ve made. I’m not going to lie, this is going to be a tough fight, but together, we can show them that District 32 has no interest in moving backwards. Will you support my reelection campaign with a donation of any amount today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240320_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]

Fellow conservative,

**I just secured the official GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in Ohio!**

Without your support, we wouldn’t have been able to pull off this victory - but our work isn’t done yet. Now we must focus on November and defeating Sherrod Brown. Now is the time for Republicans to become united, [**and together, we will do precisely that.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=320e61349955433cbef4e7ac6e9eacb4&_e=KpbUd5dFgYdnObZn_L_QYLfzL2h7XZdjQ5vgo9_s0sb2GGEWXaoyqZRjM_n5KnXx6WlyV1XXtHyeejvfsN2DYjAnJ6WgFv1eCKo4o_QxaruuzizetDNuomoUeepWgGTU1sarHhjBlAoTq3eVCo-lkyg5LhCiKdcX3b_W-U5GO_sNlxnIKi2PTA_f5kln7wK_zeAQZ5-XSp_qL8XA1DH7fAUbyktMpBJpdiNKrm1ITtXTrW7lH2hOhHBPu1uY-FJhXt5XN7Emci6kg6GDPUE9zgTxtwk7letD55xzCTT6E5APBHMy5wftzu2Ye9mJdo3t2cVRxY2qW_e4jLo5tNJdjY6gwrd2c7YtSahnrzCFURq2JYdq7mkF1XSPDcJ65boQEQs-r3fqHf0hPJZFTNrQWw%3D%3D)

Sherrod Brown is the single biggest enabler of Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda that has wrecked our country. He is:
1. For open borders - and even more illegal immigration.
2. Soft on crime - and more focused on protecting criminals than putting them in jail.
3. For runaway spending - he’s never met a dollar he couldn’t spend.
4. For nonstop taxes on hardworking Ohio families.
5. And a career politician who first ran for office when Richard Nixon was president.

**Sherrod Brown votes with Joe Biden damn near 100% of the time.** He’s sabotaged Ohio, and he’s sabotaged America, _and he’s lied to Ohio workers every step of the way._

But it’s not just me that Democrats and Washington insiders are coming after. They are also coming after President Trump. Chuck Schumer and the national Dems have spent millions tying me to President Trump.

I’ve got a message for them... **I wear my support for President Trump like a badge of honor and am proud to have his support because under him, we were safe, prosperous, and at peace.**

I’m a fourth-generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.

But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age, I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.

**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**

_Now, I’m ready for my next challenge:_ firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done, Peter.

Well, I’d say it’s hard to believe I’m emailing you about yet another potential government shutdown caused by Republican recklessness – but this situation was 100% predictable.
This Saturday at 12:01 AM is our deadline to pass spending legislation to keep the government open. And, as usual, Republicans have brought us to the brink because they just cannot get things done .

Republicans flat-out can’t govern, and the American people deserve better.
I’m going all in to flip the House and secure a Democratic majority this year so we can get back to a functioning government, but we’re going to need all hands on deck to get it done.
Will you pitch in any amount to my re-election campaign today to help make sure I can hold onto my seat and Democrats everywhere can compete in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Sara

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
It's time to rally
To showcase Bob Lorinser's strength against Rep. Jack Bergman in November, we need to rally the troops now.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/All%20of%20Uss.jpeg]
We rely on grassroots contributions to continue our momentum. There are no PACs, dark money, or ultra-wealthy donors looking for influence — it's just us, you and me, chipping in what we can.
If you've contributed recently, we are so grateful. If you can spare an additional donation today, it will be a tremendous help as we close out the quarter strong.
RUSH A $20.24 CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=20.24&refcode=express_lane_20.24]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
DONATE MORE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
The momentum we've witnessed Bob acquire over the last four months has been astounding and very encouraging.
As some campaigns struggle in the first quarter, our progress never stopped. It's because of you. Thank you.
But, friends, the truth is - to continue growing our campaign, to fund our field team, our communications outreach, yard signs, and organize our volunteers, we need campaign-sustaining donations to propel us to the top in our August primary.
As much as Bob is a proponent of campaign-finance reform, we also need to save a lot of money for the general election to invest in television advertising, mailers, and the gamut of materials required to get Bob Lorinser's name in front of voters.
We know we can win in November for a several reasons.
Rep. Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger. The last repeat-Democratic candidate in MI01 to challenge an incumbent lost by just half a percentage point in a rematch.
With you, we can absolutely do this.
Our obstacle in 2020 - first-time challengers rarely have the name recognition to make a dent in the electorate. But, the opportunity for a two-cycle strategy to work here is ripe.
In the last cycle, Bob raised more grassroots donations than any other Michigan Democrat facing an incumbent. He moved the needle for Dems by five points in our geographic area.
This year, we can do this.
We can flip this House blue.
I've never seen Bob more energized to win. Our challenge is steep, so we need a powerhouse campaigner. We can win this district back and put it back in the hands of the people.
Onward!
-Andrew

At the end of February, after years of back and forth, New York State finally confirmed the new Congressional lines. I am excited to represent the #NewNY19. I've won here, fought for these communities and affectionately call this district the place where Upstate meets Downstate.

While my opponent considered abandoning this district, I'm committed to staying in the fight for every person in NY19, regardless of political affiliation.
---
| [_Wondering how you can help win reelection?
Chip in $5, $10, or $15 to my campaign today. **Every dollar matters.**_](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=0054938197&e=a39a20e5dd)
---
|
---
|
---
I recently co-sponsored the Access to Family Building Act, becoming the first Republican to sign on to this important legislation.

I believe firmly that every woman and every family should be able to pursue their dreams of parenthood.

I thank the author of the bill, Rep. Susan Wild of Pennsylvania, for her kind words saying that I exhibited a "profile in courage" cosponsoring her bill. It was simply the right thing to do.

- [Rep. Marc Molinaro becomes first Republican to back bill protecting IVF](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=238a3b36cb&e=a39a20e5dd)
\- [CNN Interview](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=9e2ed31672&e=a39a20e5dd)
\- [CBS News Interview](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=78c98c6328&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
For too long, Upstate NY has been overlooked and forgotten. When I ran to serve you in Congress, I made it a priority to make sure our communities had a voice.

I am proud to have fought for, helped secure and deliver on a number of vital projects for our community.

- [Greene to get federal funds for water project](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=6544de04e3&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Trumansburg getting $3.5M for new EMS building](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=a08eed166b&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Southern Tier Projects Receive Funding](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=7b7b9bbb0d&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Columbia, Greene to receive funding from appropriations bills](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=b70444aba4&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Marathon ambulance gets $975,000 for new facility](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=17d8459778&e=a39a20e5dd)

|
---
As you know, advocating for our friends and family with disabilities has long been core to my public service.

I'm proud to announce that my bipartisan "Think DIFFERENTLY About Emergencies Act" - a bill to make sure no one is left behind when disaster strikes - has passed the House.

Additionally, I have put forward a bipartisan package of bills that will help break down barriers for people with disabilities - ensuring better access to healthcare, more opportunities to succeed and support for them and their caregivers.

- [U.S. Rep Molinaro (R-NY-19) Think DIFFERENTLY About Emergencies Act Passes House](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=ffd6f34d53&e=a39a20e5dd)

We are a community that believes in celebrating our differences, and I’m proud of that. But our state legislature just passed a bill that is deeply at odds with our values. This bill cruelly targets the safety and wellbeing of transgender kids by preventing them from accessing the health care they need. Look, attacking LGBTQ+ kids is just wrong, and we don’t just see it from our state legislature. It’s been one attack after another on LGBTQ+ folks since National Republicans took control of the House last year. Peter, Policies that open the door for illegal immigrants to vote in U.S. elections are spreading like wildfire across our nation, threatening the very core of our electoral integrity.

_**This dangerous trend undermines our electoral system, eroding the trust essential to the process and distorting the voices of legitimate voters.**_

🗳️ **Disenfranchises Legitimate Voters:** Allowing non-citizens to vote diminishes the representation of lawful voters, infringing upon their rights and voices in our government. Why should U.S. citizens compete with illegal immigrants when it comes to decisions on _our_ country?!

❌ **Undermines Public Trust:** If illegal immigrants can vote in our elections, Americans will never trust or accept the outcome.

🔍**Invites Voter Fraud:** The policies these radical activists are implementing leave the door wide open for misconduct in our elections.
* Without voter ID laws, how can we ensure only eligible voters are voting and that they’re only voting once?
* Without stricter mail-in voting laws, how can we ensure that every ballot received in the mail was filled out by an eligible U.S. citizen?
* And if we don’t address the border crisis, how can we ever ensure illegal immigrants aren’t entering our communities in droves?

The answer is we can’t. But recent events in Arizona show us that we _can_ fight back **and** **_win_**. **Arizona Republicans took a bold stand, enacting new laws to require proof of U.S. citizenship for voting. Despite facing challenges, these laws were upheld by a federal judge, sending a powerful message that election integrity matters.**

This dangerous trend undermines our electoral system, eroding the trust essential to the process and distorting the voices of legitimate voters. 🗳️ Disenfranchises Legitimate Voters: Allowing non-citizens to vote diminishes the representation of lawful voters, infringing upon their rights and voices in our government. Without stricter mail-in voting laws, how can we ensure that every ballot received in the mail was filled out by an eligible U.S. citizen? Despite facing challenges, these laws were upheld by a federal judge, sending a powerful message that election integrity matters. Yet, the battle is far from over. We’re carefully tracking election data and legislation and there are still 15 states with a FAILING election scorecard**. We’re working hard to bring awareness to voters, talk to legislators, and take action in the courts - but we need your support. We have to fix the problem before these states take the nation down with them. As the forefront defender of election integrity, Voter Reference Foundation is leading this charge. Fellow conservative,

**I just secured the official GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in Ohio!**

Without your support, we wouldn’t have been able to pull off this victory - but our work isn’t done yet. Now we must focus on November and defeating Sherrod Brown. Now is the time for Republicans to become united, [**and together, we will do precisely that.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ef97145812d243cbbbb50d2cb81b655c&_e=_PNH2xyfAwSeaOuCEbqw2Y-kTZagxLlJR_e9iLn-YCQ-3GiC3-6b7Q-XIZJPCO_rvPotiQwHat3xAUYKyrQGORImLQQZJuNcg_5F0WGPMXK7BW2smv0Ic6IwxmElxC2hZlNVFcjP7WiyKefrKfAzYWYjyJeaNaLV5UXHcgDKCohqzBg1ltVvcgGKpF95RhdZgg4CiCZDYh2XjD9a6pyNcs2Y1YfNHNwh9QGRQDk8PI_ScW_nuKLPykIf6RU2jqnwlNtOGw65Z7cKTTHkXeVPDWPakuiR5cF-Nh8c6Do9J2C7oRTCzkqLxOXR5QHsrM_VRr3EDPuFFIwBCiMRMEeFPVWfkKoGkv-3BaNRPYVFHFtPcg34JeTRtsgESJQDVtJsarJ60mbr0dG2oX9ZvcI2QQ%3D%3D)

Sherrod Brown is the single biggest enabler of Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda that has wrecked our country. He is:
1. For open borders - and even more illegal immigration.
2. Soft on crime - and more focused on protecting criminals than putting them in jail.
3. For runaway spending - he’s never met a dollar he couldn’t spend.
4. For nonstop taxes on hardworking Ohio families.
5. And a career politician who first ran for office when Richard Nixon was president.

**Sherrod Brown votes with Joe Biden damn near 100% of the time.** He’s sabotaged Ohio, and he’s sabotaged America, _and he’s lied to Ohio workers every step of the way._

But it’s not just me that Democrats and Washington insiders are coming after. They are also coming after President Trump. Chuck Schumer and the national Dems have spent millions tying me to President Trump.

I’ve got a message for them... **I wear my support for President Trump like a badge of honor and am proud to have his support because under him, we were safe, prosperous, and at peace.**

I wonder if Sherrod Brown would wear his blind support of Joe Biden and his policies like a badge of honor?

We know that DC Democrats will stop at nothing and spend whatever it takes to keep the chief enabler of their disastrous agenda in the Senate. [**That’s why I need your help, fellow conservative.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ef97145812d243cbbbb50d2cb81b655c&_e=_PNH2xyfAwSeaOuCEbqw2Y-kTZagxLlJR_e9iLn-YCQ-3GiC3-6b7Q-XIZJPCO_rvPotiQwHat3xAUYKyrQGORImLQQZJuNcg_5F0WGPMXK7BW2smv0Ic6IwxmElxC2hZlNVFcjP7WiyKefrKfAzYWYjyJeaNaLV5UXHcgDKCohqzBg1ltVvcgGKpF95RhdZgg4CiCZDYh2XjD9a6pyNcs2Y1YfNHNwh9QGRQDk8PI_ScW_nuKLPykIf6RU2jqnwMT3Jlva9un0b1UA-JVrKoXmWZg1U6SWzXEB-PIRX_E-cugNOJbyo9wRquoHJA-dHNnQa8DNwuFdm1zNb_lrD76Zsfe8svE-YvzbzfYPA9N-N3nAALLgNHqw0dXLfKWZsYopEVQrXxUuKqbA7LKA5ng%3D%3D)

I had a target on my back before this victory, and now that I am officially the Republican nominee to take on DC insider Sherrod Brown, they are ready to spend over $100 million in this race.

We don’t need $100 million, but we do need you to put some skin in the game (and chip in again, too).

[**So, I am personally asking for your support. Even just $5 will go a long way to flip this seat, help Republicans win back the Senate majority, and finally retire career politician Sherrod Brown!**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ef97145812d243cbbbb50d2cb81b655c&_e=_PNH2xyfAwSeaOuCEbqw2Y-kTZagxLlJR_e9iLn-YCQ-3GiC3-6b7Q-XIZJPCO_rvPotiQwHat3xAUYKyrQGORImLQQZJuNcg_5F0WGPMXK7BW2smv0Ic6IwxmElxC2hZlNVFcjP7WiyKefrKfAzYWYjyJeaNaLV5UXHcgDKCohqzBg1ltVvcgGKpF95RhdZgg4CiCZDYh2XjD9a6pyNcs2Y1YfNHNwh9QGRQDk8PI_ScW_nuKLPykIf6RU2jqnwsU8YrYk2mXHG0eOORAEW4yEuoCCNp7uSEmHZpcpu5Yx7IYOXrW9os_obPkoFJH3QoZCJpqZgqBtgrGtJZx04z-5swbsTrOAn3efc7beZi5yVnNZiiMz6IXo-VGYCRRNgb2nGTTEWgAdDWeKJhYv9IQ%3D%3D)

I hope I can count on you,

Bernie Moreno
Republican for U.S. Senate - Ohio

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. | Peter, While many of you know my story, I know quite a few folks don’t know my background and how I became a member of Congress.

Growing up as the daughter of an Air Force officer, I moved frequently throughout my childhood—both around the United States and across the world. I moved to the Lehigh Valley more than thirty years ago to raise my family, and in this vibrant community, I discovered a sense of belonging. This district is the only place I’ve ever truly called home.

The Lehigh Valley holds a special significance in my life—it’s where my two children, Clay and Adrienne, were born, attended public schools, and grew up. It's also where I established a reputable legal practice and became the first female Solicitor of the City of Allentown.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81344733/462151216/-1109429436?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-03-20_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZjYwMDlhMC0wMWU3LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H9hzISvoY6R1nXRb7IYaq_Q1jN-VrtUtmnNqb-q5xbA=)
In 2018, I made history by becoming the first woman to represent the Lehigh Valley in Congress. In Congress, I’ve worked every day to fight for the people of PA-07, including lowering prescription drug prices, addressing our country’s mental health crisis, supporting our veterans, and more.

Hi Friend,
Thanks for joining the conversation about how we can get Congress back on track and focused on the things that matter to us Texans.
As I shared in my last email, I am running for U.S. Congress because we need leaders who can get back to the work of governing. Over the next eight months, I’ll be reaching out to share my vision for what our future could look like — one thing’s for sure, our best future doesn’t include extremist MAGA leaders like Donald Trump or my opponent, John Carter.
[**Today, I want to hear from you...**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=78a3ab661e&e=b9b3f70fc1)
I know you are hearing a lot right now about the issues that divide us. It’s everywhere — from the internet, our phones, the tv, even sometimes the dinner table. Listening in, it’s all too easy to conclude that our country is so deeply divided the damage is perhaps irreparable.
I don’t believe that narrative, and I hope you don’t either.
[**Click here**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=7d94373820&e=b9b3f70fc1) and let me know [**your top three favorite things in Texas**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=374804f6b9&e=b9b3f70fc1) that help unite us.
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=41e07d9423&e=b9b3f70fc1)
_Why am I asking?_
Because **I believe that we have much more in common than divides us.**
Complex questions over the role of government, what issues require immediate action, and how we should move forward as a society cannot be reduced to a single question: _red or blue?_
The sum total of who we are, what we believe, and what our families are going through will never be reflected in an individual metric with one easy-to-arrive-at answer. And it certainly won’t be as simple as a political party.
The truth is that **life is far more complicated.**
**It’s time we pushed back on the us-versus-them narrative.** We should be emphasizing what unites us, not what threatens to pull us apart — heck even Friday night lights help bring us Texans together.
| [Take our survey ›››](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=d4ce0abd68&e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
I’m not naive. Our state is facing a number of serious challenges, and there is significantly more work that needs to be done as we build a better Texas together. But our work on those issues shouldn’t cause us to lose sight of the many things that bring us together, make us stronger, and benefit all of us.
And that’s what I want to hear from you: [**What three things do you love about our district that help unite us as a community?**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=23c1c9718d&e=b9b3f70fc1)
With gratitude,
Stuart WhitlowDemocrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-brown [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-brown]

Team, it's official: the general election is here!

I couldn't be more honored to represent the people of Ohio and have the opportunity to keep fighting for the Dignity of Work in the Senate. I want to personally thank every member of this team – including you – for powering our grassroots movement this far.

All we have accomplished together so far makes it clearer than ever, Ohio voters want someone who will fight for them in the Senate. Better wages and working conditions, reproductive freedom, affordable housing and health care – I promise to keep up these critical fights for all of us.

But our real fight starts now, friend. We now have an official opponent, Bernie Moreno, and he's a deep-pocketed Donald Trump ally that's ready to spend millions of dollars to try to buy this seat. Polls show this race is neck and neck, Republicans are already spending record-breaking sums to defeat me and flip the Senate red, and it's only going to get worse.

So I'm personally asking: Will you split $10 or more right now between my campaign and Jason Crow’s to make sure we have the resources to fight back against GOP attacks, protect this seat, and keep the Senate blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-brown?amount=10]

Fellow American,

**I’m trying not to panic, but I can’t contain myself any longer. I need your help.**

The FEC mandates that we submit and publish our quarterly fundraising numbers on March 31. This means that the Democrats will see that I’m way behind my End-of-Quarter fundraising goal, which can only mean one thing – they’ll throw everything they have into this race to drown me out and cut the power on my campaign.

**Desperate times call for desperate measures.**

**[I’m activating a 25X IMPACT BONUS on all donations until the FEC deadline. I need just 40 Patriots to donate $30 to hit my goal. Will you be one of my saviors, friend?](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=16a4159272074f65b69ce7bd89449287&_e=si6qD8bRqptv6DSe4IQ5JLbuCv9ee7MRnbMUbBk5MuYMCwyHNNAfYE69408vH19nZ-fxUS7vCFM2IizrS5Hs8hpObArgm6uX31bYo2CEsqOjG3FSVHtc_VV1lhGnoamjhFpA2Q6ou03jxkpO-0s7ys6K6xebsAI95Va2MR1Mvpa_2FIkaqekeOXmIdBOJdJTlX1w2rEN5g-Tf9kxSP1U98U85B3U96Bb22U3ozJNmQZyPEkxODSc39DZ8VQ-l9qzc9WpV5I0toFlCnb04_4wzJFtXe4AsnssTgT8SH5JJ62v4GU7DPyFTf1cCDvbJWH_-meATmyT_QPWeWO4R088YMf3WKGHEquWeg5udhxLCGBgDV5zVe-Bj7uGBKedYpAskTQ2-5NuV5UYcZmmU_C77A%3D%3D)**

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Do this one thing to stand for life today
body:
highlight-blue {background-color: #648fc6;}
In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles

|
---
| | From the Desk of Marjorie Dannenfelser Hello, In our fast-paced world, it's easy to lose sight of fundamental principles, especially when it comes to complex issues. Rather than trying to understand or get involved, so often I find it's easier for people to turn a blind eye. Recently, I feel like the culture in our country has forgotten - or ignored - the most basic lessons. I've felt a growing concern about how our society perceives and values life, particularly when it comes to the development of human life. Science and research tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. We know exactly when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, can wiggle their toes, and even hear their mother's voice. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are treated as though they are not alive or even human in our society. **After speaking to the experts and talking to mothers for over 30 years as a pro-life activist, I can assure you that they are very much alive.** Our Creator has given us life as a precious gift. No person is disposable, and every life has value because we are made in His image. I believe that everyone deserves life, despite what our society, schools, or government say. I believe that together we can make a difference in our culture that has drifted off course. I believe we can bring dignity and a voice to the voiceless. I also strongly believe I'm not alone in my convictions. I believe that you believe this too. SBA Pro-Life America works everyday to bring the truth about abortion to light and shine a ray of hope into our culture. We want to give the next generation of Americans a bright future. But this future will require commitment from people like you. The first step we must all take is clearly stating what we believe and what we're willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me and be a voice for the voiceless? Will you stand up for those that cannot do it for themselves? I've created a pro-life pledge and I'd love your support. You can join over 1 million pro-life supporters - people like you - that want to see the unborn protected, valued, and cherished. [https://action.sbaprolife.org/stand-for-life-with-me](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0KzB3iF_wsI-hZHJJMk0ag~~/AARclAA~/RgRn3e68P0S1aHR0cHM6Ly9hY3Rpb24uc2JhcHJvbGlmZS5vcmcvc3RhbmQtZm9yLWxpZmUtd2l0aC1tZT91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249c3RhbmRfd2l0aF9tZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmYXBwZWFsX2lkPTEwNzYmcGFja2FnZV9pZD0yNzE0NyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1UX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMyMFcDc3BjQgpl77lZ-2VCIfswUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) For Life,

As we speak, we are witnessing an **unprecedented assault on reproductive rights and bodily autonomy.** Between the overturn of _Roe v.
