clean_body: | | | | | Peter, I want to take a minute to introduce myself. My name is Hung Cao. I’m a 25-year Navy combat veteran, and I love America so much that I put my life on the line for her time and time again. I fought on the front lines in some of the most dangerous war zones in the world, from Iraq to Afghanistan to Somalia. I’ve seen the world many times over, and trust me when I tell you - if America falls, there is nowhere else to go. I saw too many of my fellow servicemen and women fall to the enemy. But their sacrifices were never in vain, because they fought for the greatest country on Earth. My team and I dedicated our lives to taking on our enemies abroad. But now, our greatest enemy lies within our borders. The radical Biden Administration and socialists in Congress are bending the knee to the same enemies my fellow soldiers put their lives on the line to defeat. They’re trampling on the rights men and women in uniform made the ultimate sacrifice to defend. I’m not the kind of person to stand by idly when our country needs help - and that’s why I’m running for Senate. I’m going to be honest with you - Joe Biden, Tim Kaine, and the DC establishment desperately want me to call it quits. They know I won’t give into their games and cater to the establishment elites, and that makes them absolutely FURIOUS. But I’m not a politician, I’m a fighter. The same values I fought for in the Navy are under attack by politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and Tim Kaine, and I want YOU to stand with me in my fight to save our country before it’s too late. Together, we can take back our country from the radical Left and make sure America continues to be the greatest nation on Earth. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

# FROM THE DESK OF MONICA CROWLEY
---
| | Dear Reader,We’re headed deep into election season and the future of our country is at stake.

One of the things that deeply concerns me is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

**It’s for this reason that the recent revival of the famed New York Sun is so vital.**

Peter,
Everyone deserves a safe, affordable place to call home. Yet far too often, rent skyrockets while landlords refuse to adequately maintain their properties.
A few years ago, people suffered when a hedge fund owned landlord let their properties fall into disrepair. No Minnesotan should have to live in a home that loses heat, lacks hot water, and is infested with pests and mold due to a landlord's negligence. So, we sued them.
**Late last week, they settled – agreeing to pay tenants $2.2 million and forgive another $2 million in outstanding rent. This is a huge win for Minnesota renters.**
This settlement is a signal to landlords that they cannot use their legal and economic power over renters to take advantage of them. And when they do, I’ll continue to stand up to them and fight for hard-working Minnesotans who deserve better than substandard housing.
You elected me Attorney General to ensure that every Minnesotan can live with dignity, safety, and respect. None of this would be possible without you and the grassroots movement we’ve built together, and we’re not stopping here.

body:
Peter, Ohio's primary is over, and now, it's official: **We're going up against Donald Trump's handpicked candidate Bernie Moreno in the race experts say could decide Senate control.**

And it's not just Moreno we're up against. National Republicans are going ALL IN to flip this seat red – they're already spending record amounts to defeat me. We need to fight back ASAP, or we could risk entering the general election at a disadvantage.

**So I'm personally asking:** [**Please, will you split $5 or more now between my campaign and Shontel Brown's to help me defend Ohio's critical seat and keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81349882/462160125/1368611189?refcode=EM_F_240320split_N_SB_90DO_6_NG_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWJiODQ5Ni0wZGU3LWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NRS2b8IdizZsFQ5m9KUOr2TIajj3ymq5LhBK42p7cio=)

In case you need a reminder, my opponent and I couldn't be more different:
* He wants a national abortion ban, **I want to restore Roe v. Wade.**
* He protects the wealthiest 1%, **I defend American workers.**
* He'll do Trump's and McConnell's bidding in the Senate, **I'm a champion for democracy.**

Sherrod Brown is the single biggest enabler of Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda that has wrecked our country. He is:
1. For open borders - and even more illegal immigration.
2. Soft on crime - and more focused on protecting criminals than putting them in jail.
3. For runaway spending - he’s never met a dollar he couldn’t spend.
4. For nonstop taxes on hardworking Ohio families.
5. And a career politician who first ran for office when Richard Nixon was president.

**Sherrod Brown votes with Joe Biden damn near 100% of the time.** He’s sabotaged Ohio, and he’s sabotaged America, _and he’s lied to Ohio workers every step of the way._

But it’s not just me that Democrats and Washington insiders are coming after. They are also coming after President Trump. Chuck Schumer and the national Dems have spent millions tying me to President Trump.

I’ve got a message for them... **I wear my support for President Trump like a badge of honor and am proud to have his support because under him, we were safe, prosperous, and at peace.**

name: Jim Carris
subject: Thank You
body:
Peter -I wanted to take a moment to thank you for making me your choice for the Republican nominee to take on the Democrats this November. Our message of electing a true independent leader - one that will work in a bipartisan manner to deliver results for the families of the 10th District and beholden only to the voters and not a political machine - is resonating throughout the district.Since day one, I have been amazed at the support my campaign has received. The number of people who have been activated - whether by volunteering their time, hosting events, or financially supporting my campaign is nothing short of amazing.I want to thank you for being with us throughout this first phase of this campaign, and I cannot express my gratitude deeply enough.I know that things will only get harder as we approach November, but with your continued support, I know we can overcome the challenges that come our way.
